Peter, everything we've fought for is at risk.

David Valadao and his Republican allies have reserved $14.3 million to hold this seat, the most ever committed to defending him.

We're seeing extreme spending across the country as Republicans desperately try to distract from their record of gutting health care access and dragging us into a war with Iran that has spiked gas prices.

**The only difference in CA-22 is the sheer scale of the attacks. We’re a top target.**

We have the momentum to win, but plenty of Valley voters are still undecided, and $14.3 million in TV ads can change a lot of minds fast.

Thankfully, we've beaten this playbook before. In the primary, outside groups spent more than $4 million trying to stop me, and grassroots supporters carried us to victory anyway.

**We don't need to outraise the billionairess, but the people funding this campaign have to outnumber them. I'm counting on you, Peter. **I never imagined that I would become one of Donald Trump’s most outspoken opponents.**

I grew up in a working-class, conservative Catholic family in El Paso, Texas. My mother was a Mexican immigrant who became an American citizen. My father was a lifelong truck driver. The Fourth of July was practically sacred in our home.

I was raised to believe in hard work, personal responsibility, service and love of country.

After September 11th, I felt called to serve. I went to work at the Pentagon, spent a year in Iraq and served our country in national-security and counterterrorism positions under both Republican and Democratic presidents.

Eventually, I was asked to serve as Vice President Mike Pence’s homeland security and counterterrorism adviser.

I sat in the Situation Room. I staffed the White House Coronavirus Task Force. I entered those rooms believing that, no matter our political differences, everyone entrusted with the security of the American people would understand that the country came first.

Then I saw what was really happening behind closed doors.

**I watched Donald Trump treat a deadly pandemic like a political and public-relations problem. I watched expertise get dismissed, the truth get bent and dedicated public servants get pushed aside because they would not place loyalty to one man above their oath to the country.**

Decisions that affected millions of American families were repeatedly reduced to one question: What was best for Donald Trump?

For a long time, I told myself that staying meant I could help. That perhaps I could prevent something worse from happening.

But eventually, I had to ask myself a much harder question:

Was I helping protect the country -- or was my presence helping legitimize something I knew was dangerous?

In 2020, I resigned from the Trump administration. Then I went public.

I was terrified.

I knew speaking out could cost me my career, my livelihood and my family’s safety. The attacks came quickly. There were threats, smears and attempts to intimidate me into silence.

But silence costs more.

So I spoke out. I supported Joe Biden. I stood on the stage at the Democratic National Convention and supported Kamala Harris. And after spending most of my life as a Republican, I eventually became a Democrat.

Not because every belief I held changed overnight. Not because I suddenly agreed with every Democrat on every issue.

I became a Democrat because there comes a moment when party loyalty becomes complicity -- and country must come first.

Now, Trump is back in the White House, the guardrails are weaker, and Republicans in Congress have repeatedly chosen obedience over oversight. MAGA is no longer merely threatening to abuse power. We are living with the consequences.

**That is why I am writing to you today on behalf of Resist Reclaim Rebuild.**

Resist Reclaim Rebuild is a group of Democratic activists working to defeat MAGA candidates in the battleground races that will determine whether Donald Trump continues to enjoy virtually unchecked power -- or whether we elect a Congress capable of standing up to him.

They understand that resistance cannot exist only in speeches, television interviews, or social media posts.

It MUST reach the ballot box.

It MUST be organized.

And it MUST be focused on the races where a relatively small number of votes could mean the difference between a MAGA rubber stamp and a real check on Donald Trump’s power.

[**So, I'm asking personally: Will you donate $10, $25 or whatever you can afford today to help Resist Reclaim Rebuild defeat MAGA in the battleground races that matter most?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139902529/648890242/-323302678?refcode=260916_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2MwMTYwYmUtNzRiOC1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BUHlWcPunqAAUBIDEHytyT8oJD35iubREfwHNUL6jPU=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139902530/648890243/949025562?refcode=260916_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2MwMTYwYmUtNzRiOC1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BUHlWcPunqAAUBIDEHytyT8oJD35iubREfwHNUL6jPU=)
---

I learned the opposite.

I learned that courage is contagious.

Control of Congress could come down to only a handful of seats. Your contribution can help elect Democrats who will defend our Constitution, demand accountability and finally place a meaningful check on Trump’s unfettered power.

Please help Resist Reclaim Rebuild fight for those victories today.

But above all, refuse to be silent.

Olivia Troye

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Congress must act on AI
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
For AI to have any good, we must protect against its harm.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3885%2E21716%2E2PAtQV)
Right now, with AI, we’re staring down potentially the biggest change for humanity since we went from being nomadic creatures to stationary, community-based societies.
**Whether you think AI will be a fountain of youth or a doomsday technology or something in between, its power — both now and in the future — is indisputable.**
It has the potential to cure diseases, or to produce bioweapons. To protect against the most advanced cyberattacks, or to hack the most robust technological fortresses. To foster shared prosperity for the many, or to amass unimaginable wealth for the few.
Each of these outcomes are different sides of the same coin. And no concentration of such power can be allowed to go unchecked or unrestrained. It certainly can’t go unregulated.
That’s why I’ve been calling on my colleagues in Congress to meet this moment and marshal our collective power to both regulate AI domestically and push for an “arms control” approach to AI globally.
**That means human-centric laws that protect our economy, our finances, our privacy, our health, our democracy, and even our very existence.**
For AI to have any good, we must protect against its harm. And the clock is ticking — as we’ve seen with other technologies in the past, the longer we wait, the harder it becomes.
Right now, whistleblowers are warning us, AI CEOs are requesting regulations, and people all over this country are demanding it, too.
That’s why I’m going to keep fighting to fulfill our responsibility to our constituents and to humanity. And since Republican leaders in Congress are currently refusing to take action, it seems we’re going to have to flip the House this November to get it done.
[**So, if you’re with me, can I count on you to pitch in $5 to help me win re-election and support Democrats across the country in this year’s midterms?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260924-2.DqpMml&refcode=em20260924-3885&amount=5&t=2&akid=3885%2E21716%2E2PAtQV)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260924-2.DqpMml&amount=5&refcode=em20260924-3885&t=21&akid=3885%2E21716%2E2PAtQV)**
Together, we can mitigate the risks associated with AI and ensure that it becomes a tool that benefits _all_ of us. But only if we act with urgency.
In solidarity,
Sarah McBride

Scoreboard: Trump 0, free press 1 | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139902550/648892030/-785282667?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDJjYjgxYi03NWI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sd9y_rC3wm1RsoA5YlpTAI7Q5uDW5cbXbT8QLmQCoEA=)

Peter, We watched something happen today that's exactly the kind of energy we need RIGHT NOW. Let me set the scene: last Saturday, the White House banned three newsrooms, CNN, Politico, and MS NOW, from setting foot on the grounds. No hearing. No warning. Just gone, because Trump didn't like what they were writing about him. **We all watched that happen and thought: this isn't just petty, this is actually illegal. Turns out the reporters thought so too. And they sued.** Then this morning, a federal judge agreed with them! They called the ban almost certainly unconstitutional and ordered the White House to let them back in,**immediately.** _And the White House just... didn't. Reporters stood outside the gate, court order in hand, and still got turned away. ** Jonny’s Team Needs YOU 🫵
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Friend,

Did you receive our summer survey in late August? We texted thousands of CD-04 residents and asked about the issues most important to them, how they view Representative Kennedy’s performance in Congress, and how they’re thinking about voting in November. We had terrific responses overall with very few surprises - government accountability, cost of living, the economy, and access to health care are the top federal issues on everyone’s minds. We’re excited to share some more snippets in upcoming messages over the next few weeks.

How many days until...

Wednesday, September 23, 6:30 pm - 7:30 pm
* Meet & Greet with Jonny and Shana (https://www.facebook.com/events/1685293135871176/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Bill & Cathy Popadich invite you to join us at Draper Peaks Condo Clubhouse for a meet & greet with Jonny Larsen running for Congress in the 4th district and Shana Anderson (https://www.andersonforutah.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) running for Utah Senate 19. Shana, Jonny, and Bill are veterans who served our country. The best way to thank a veteran is to vote for one this midterm.Invite your friends, family, neighbors, and co-workers. Everyone is welcome. Come join us and help support these candidates as approach the election! Draper Peaks Condo Clubhouse, 195 Spencer Peak Way, Draper (Park in Cinemark Lot)

Wednesday, September 30th, 6:30 pm - 8 pm
* Strong Futures Start Small (https://actionnetwork.org/events/strong-futures-start-small-utah-county?source=direct_link&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Join us for a nonpartisan event focused on the childcare crisis, where parents, early childhood educators, providers, legislators, and candidates gather for an informal meet-and-greet. The focus is on listening, connecting, and hearing directly from the families and providers who are experiencing the challenges of early childhood care every day. Questions? email careforkids@uaeyc.org (mailto:careforkids@uaeyc.org?subject=&body=) Provo Library, (Bullock Room, #309) 550 N University Ave., Provo, UT

------------------------------------------------------------

You'll not only help us, but other candidates like, Lillian Bowels (https://www.lillianbowles.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Benyde Walker (https://www.benydewalker.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Rod Moser (https://www.utahgrit.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Brett Nielsen (https://www.brettforutah.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=71d9eaa3e8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=71d9eaa3e8&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and many others that need extra hands. When we work together as a team, anything is possible.

Email Alex at fieldops@jonnyutah4congress.com (mailto:fieldops@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=RSVP%20for%209%2F15%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny&body=) to join the canvass team!

Working for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time.

We need to fill some specialty roles as well as have volunteers to accompany us for events, town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an ALL HANDS ON DECK request!

Dear Members of Congress,

As of today, I urgently demand you to remove Donald Trump from office.

Because of his erratic and unconstitutional behavior, our democracy is on the verge of collapse. _Millions of Americans are paying the price for his authoritarian agenda._

_→ He’s trying to IMPRISON anyone he disagrees with, from Jack Smith to Dr. Fauci._
_→ He’s threatening to deplete Social Security and eliminate Medicaid._
_→ He’s even attempting to declare a national emergency to control our elections._

**This simply can’t wait. We have to hold him accountable. Right now.**

[I'm signing this letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to elect Democrats who will stand up to Trump and his MAGA agenda. Your job as elected officials is to defend our democracy — it is time for you to act. »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/132454?t=9&akid=29066%2E878179%2EehUaMn) | [DONATE $3: SIGN YOUR NAME CALLING FOR TRUMP’S REMOVAL »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/132454?t=10&akid=29066%2E878179%2EehUaMn)

_Willis_

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Taking Texans’ health to the TOP! 🩺
body:
| __ |

**Lea el boletín en español abajo**

**We just launched our statewide healthcare justice campaign!** ** ** **It's official! TOP publicly launched a new organizing campaign aimed at overhauling healthcare in Texas at a press conference in the heart of Houston’s Medical Center on Tuesday.** This campaign is rooted in TOP’s unwavering stance that healthcare is a human right, and that access to quality, affordable healthcare is a racial and economic justice issue. Fighting for healthcare justice isn’t new to TOP. For over a decade, we've engaged over a million Black and Latino Texans across the state on issues like healthcare quality, access, and affordability. We've hosted clinics to inform communities about the Affordable Care Act, targeted the over 1 million Texans that fall in the Medicaid expansion gap, and have championed policies to improve maternal health outcomes for Black women. “Yes, we’ve been winning policies to make people’s lives better at the local level, but we know overhauling this system is so much bigger and will require a different kind of fight,” said Brianna Brown, TOP Executive Director during the press conference. “This is why TOP is launching our statewide campaign today – because in every corner of this state, Texans are being hurt by a system that puts corporate profits over our health.” **[_Watch the press conference_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903947/648932731/-453137656?usp=sharing&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997), and [_share our photos on Facebook!_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903948/648932732/1653976854?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)** For more information about this campaign launch, email Sofia at [_**slopez@organizetexas.org**_](mailto:slopez@organizetexas.org).
**Condemning ICE's latest shooting in Austin, Texas** **TOP is outraged that once more, ICE has endangered lives and inflicted harm on our communities with the shooting of Wilber Rafael Garces Perez of Austin on Sunday.** Our hearts go out to Wilber and his family, as we hope he makes a swift, full recovery. We call for his immediate release from ICE custody, so he can return to his loved ones. With each passing day, ICE is losing more and more public trust through its senseless acts. It’s inexcusable, infuriating, and underscores how much we need this agency out of our communities. A person’s immigration status – no matter their race, nationality, or language they speak – should in **NO WAY** ever give anyone an okay to attack and shoot someone. Instilling fear in communities is not how we increase public safety. Intimidating groups of people does not get us closer to public safety. **As an organization rooted in Black and Latino solidarity, we echo the calls of Austin elected officials demanding full transparency, the release of unedited footage, and an independent investigation into this avoidable shooting.** [_**Watch this news clip featuring TOP's Dr. Doshie Piper speak in response.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903949/648932733/-1261439193?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)
**In Washington D.C. to protect our voting rights** **TOP staff and members from Dallas, San Antonio, and Houston joined Popular Democracy in Washington D.C. for a summit and congressional visits aimed at protecting voting rights earlier this month.** All year, Trump and MAGA have amplified their mass voter fraud and "stolen election" lies to try to restrict voting access ahead of this midterm. While fortunately the Supreme Court last week denied the Trump administration’s request to implement their mail-in voting restrictions, we know Republicans will still try to sow confusion and make access to the ballot box more difficult as we get closer to November. **[Check out our member testimonies here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903950/648932734/2085779520?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997) **

**Español** **Acabamos de lanzar nuestra campaña estatal de la justicia a la atención médica** **Es oficial. El martes, TOP lanzó públicamente una nueva campaña de organización destinada a transformar el sistema de salud de Texas, durante una conferencia de prensa celebrada en el corazón del Centro Médico de Houston.** Esta campaña se basa en la firme convicción de TOP de que la atención médica es un derecho humano y de que el acceso a servicios de salud de calidad y asequibles es una cuestión de justicia racial y económica. La lucha por la justicia en la atención médica no es algo nuevo para TOP. Durante más de una década, hemos movilizado a más de un millón de tejanos afrodescendientes y latinos en todo el estado en torno a temas como la calidad, el acceso y la asequibilidad de la atención médica. Hemos organizado jornadas informativas para las comunidades sobre la Ley de Cuidado de Salud a Bajo Precio (Affordable Care Act), nos hemos enfocado en el más de un millón de tejanos que quedan fuera de la cobertura debido a la falta de expansión de Medicaid y hemos impulsado políticas para mejorar los resultados de salud materna de las mujeres afrodescendientes. **Condenando el más reciente tiroteo protagagonizado por ICE en Austin, Texas** **En TOP estamos indignados porque, una vez más, ICE ha puesto vidas en peligro y ha causado daño a nuestras comunidades con el tiroteo contra Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez, de Austin, ocurrido el domingo.** Nuestros pensamientos están con Wilber y su familia, y esperamos que tenga una recuperación rápida y completa. Exigimos su liberación inmediata de la custodia de ICE para que pueda regresar con sus seres queridos. Con cada día que pasa, ICE pierde cada vez más la confianza del público debido a sus acciones insensatas. Es algo inexcusable e indignante, y pone de relieve la gran necesidad de sacar a esta agencia de nuestras comunidades. El estatus migratorio de una persona —sin importar su raza, nacionalidad o idioma— no debe, bajo NINGUNA circunstancia, dar pie a que alguien ataque y dispare contra otra persona. Sembrar el miedo en las comunidades no es la forma de aumentar la seguridad pública. Intimidar a grupos de personas no nos acerca a la seguridad pública. **Como organización arraigada en la solidaridad entre las comunidades afrodescendientes y latina, nos sumamos a las voces de los funcionarios electos de Austin que exigen total transparencia, la publicación de las grabaciones sin editar y una investigación independiente sobre este tiroteo evitable.** _**[Vea este reportaje en el que la Dra. Doshie Piper, de TOP, ofrece declaraciones al respecto.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903954/648932738/-724932509?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)**_
**En Washington D.C. para proteger nuestros derechos de voto** **Personal y miembros de TOP provenientes de Dallas, San Antonio y Houston se unieron a Popular Democracy en Washington D.C. para participar en una cumbre y realizar visitas al Congreso con el objetivo de proteger el derecho al voto a principios de este mes.** Durante todo el año, Trump y el movimiento MAGA han intensificado sus falsas afirmaciones sobre un fraude electoral masivo y el "robo de las elecciones" para intentar restringir el acceso al voto de cara a las elecciones de mitad de término. Aunque afortunadamente la semana pasada la Corte Suprema rechazó la solicitud del gobierno de Trump de implementar restricciones al voto por correo, sabemos que los republicanos seguirán intentando sembrar confusión y dificultar el acceso a las urnas a medida que nos acercamos a noviembre. [_**Consulta aquí los testimonios de nuestros miembros.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139903955/648932739/2085779520?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY3OGQzZi04NGI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VnMk3qtjsyPEJiOf_0Fzci8YQEWgo3CdEfdi6Zp9Wig=&emci=099a262d-7eb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=53678d3f-84b8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)

| **UNH Online “Polling” Continues to Mislead Vermonters**
The University of New Hampshire released another one of its off the mark online polls today, this time showing Governor Scott down six points to his Democratic challenger.

The good news is, besides exciting headlines and political posturing, outlier polls don’t matter.

_**Election Day does**._

Vermonters continue to strongly support Governor Scott and share his agenda of building a more affordable Vermont. We hope they elect a legislature that will actually work with him to advance those objectives, and move away from the policies the majority party has imposed that have made Vermont unaffordable for its residents.

Before the coverage begins, it’s important for Vermonters to have context.

**What’s buried in the fine print is that of the 882 people sampled, 508 identified as Democrats, while only 258 were Republicans and merely 78 considered themselves Independents. This isn’t new with this pollster’s methodology, which has consistently underestimated the Governor by double digits.

In 2022, their survey missed the mark by 30%, predicting a 17% margin while the Governor ended up winning by 47%.

The same happened in 2024. They estimated a 28% margin in August and a 39% margin just days before the election—but on election night, the Governor’s margin of victory was well over 50%.**

“This online poll amounts to statistical malpractice,” Dustin Degree, Governor Scott’s campaign manager, said. “Using an online poll that inflates one party to 60% of the electorate and ignores the tens of thousands of independents—then placing it into the arena as scientific political work—is why we see such a lack of consistency and trust in public polling today,” he added.

“Double digit misses aren’t simple mistakes; they’re fundamental flaws in how they conduct their research. Our democracy needs people doing this work, and it’s hard for us to criticize honest effort in this space. But when a group is so consistently wrong, this often, it is incumbent upon that group to take a hard look at what it’s doing to try to be better,” Degree added.

**_One thing we're sure of is that the other side will be working hard to take advantage of this to raise money, and we'll need your help to push back.

Please consider a contribution today._**

Thanks -

Team Scott

name: Roy Cooper
subject: A decision that wasn't made lightly
body:
I can’t do this alone, Peter.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&source=&t=1&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m in a bit of a bind.
A new poll shows that our race is now statistically tied, and the Senate GOP’s top super PACs are currently outspending us to boost my Republican opponent. That’s because Senate control hinges on this battleground race.
Since I’m running a grassroots campaign, I can’t fight back without you. So if you’re able to chip in a few bucks to power our fight today, I’d really appreciate it. Here’s the link to donate:
[**_https:/actblue.com/donate_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&amount=5&t=8&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ)
Now, my decision to run for Senate wasn’t made lightly.
Serving as Governor was one of the great experiences of my life, but after my second term, I was ready to hang up my suit and tie. From adding hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs to giving school teachers much-needed raises to expanding access to Medicaid, **my #1 priority was to improve the lives of everyday people – and we did that.**
That’s why it’s so upsetting to see how Washington DC insiders have turned their backs on hardworking people. Insiders like Michael Whatley, my opponent in this race.
My opponent says he’ll lower costs, but he built his career promoting the interests of Big Oil and utility companies at the expense of working families. He says he’ll protect our communities, but as chair of the state GOP, he appointed a convicted child sex offender who served six years in prison to powerful leadership roles within the party because he could raise money. He claims he’ll fight for North Carolinians, but it’s clear that **_his_ priority is choosing himself and his wealthy friends.**
_It’s no wonder why the President anointed him to run after Thom Tillis bowed out of running for this seat._
So while I didn’t plan to go to Washington DC, I couldn’t stand by and watch the GOP rip away health care access, gut resources for public education and chip away at the middle class. They are not making this country “great again.”
I had to get back in the fight, and I’m so glad I did.
Ever since launching this campaign, hundreds of thousands of folks like you have joined our grassroots movement for change, and momentum is on our side.
The hard part will be maintaining it for the next six weeks or so left in this race.
Republicans are spending more than $100 million so far to turn voters against me and save their Senate majority – and this surge of dark money is taking a toll on our narrow polling lead.
We can fight back and win in North Carolina, but just as in elections past, I can’t do it alone.
**[_Please, Peter – will you chip in what you can today to help me flip this seat, retake the Senate for Democrats and return power in Washington DC to the hands of working families?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&amount=5&t=9&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&amount=5&t=10&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ)

Thanks for being on this team.
Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&t=2&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1419&source=&t=3&akid=3798%2E124072%2EttQSvJ)

name: Marc Elias
subject: My update on Trump's latest attack in NH:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
This is a coordinated strategy to intimidate voters and tilt the midterms to the GOP.
Hi there, it's Marc Elias.
I’ll get right to the point: We have less than 50 days until the midterm elections, **[and I’m asking you to split a donation of $5 between Chris Pappas’s campaign and the DSCC to help flip the Senate blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260925_1.7gAYCf&refcode=em20260925-1&t=1&akid=9132%2E582294%2EokpqFC)**
Here is why your support right now is so critical:
* Republicans view New Hampshire as one of their best opportunities to flip a Senate seat.
* GOP super PACs and dark money groups are pledging millions to back Chris’s opponent John Sununu and move the Granite State backward.
* MAGA billionaires are determined to buy this open Senate seat and notch another rubber stamp for Donald Trump’s reckless agenda.

We just won a massive victory in court striking down New Hampshire's unconstitutional HB 1569 voter suppression law – but now Trump’s DOJ is deploying federal "election monitors" directly into Manchester and Nashua, demanding access to private state voter records, and threatening local election officials.
Make no mistake: This isn’t about election integrity. It’s a coordinated strategy to intimidate voters and tilt the midterms in the GOP’s favor.
**I spend my days fighting these unconstitutional attacks in court, but litigation alone won't protect this seat. We need a pro-democracy firewall in the Senate, and that starts with electing Chris Pappas.**
**[Before our crucial fundraising deadline, will you split $5 or more between Chris Pappas and the DSCC to elect candidates who will fight back against voter suppression and help flip the Senate blue?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260925_1.7gAYCf&refcode=em20260925-1&t=2&akid=9132%2E582294%2EokpqFC)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260925_1.7gAYCf&amount=5&refcode=em20260925-1&t=21&akid=9132%2E582294%2EokpqFC)**
The GOP is counting on exhaustion and resignation to win this election. We cannot – and will not – give them either.
Thank you for standing up for our democracy,
Marc Elias

Here's what I know about TN-05. Voters here are tired of being ignored. They're tired of paying too much for gas, groceries, and healthcare while their congressman does nothing about it. They're tired of a political class that puts itself first. And every single door our team knocks on, every phone call our volunteers make, every conversation I have across all 17 counties of this district tells me the same thing: they're ready for something different.

**_Four points is not a mountain. It's a mission._** And I've been on this mission for a year now, through redistricting, through a relaunch, through everything they threw at us, because I believe this district deserves better, and I'm not going to stop until we deliver it.

---

We're told elections are just about "mobilization" now, and that everyone is "sorted" and "polarized." That's certainly more true than in the past, but it's still not the whole truth. People still change their minds. I saw it all the time as a candidate and I still do. People want to be persuaded, and that's a big part of what makes us a democracy. It's one of the few things Trump can't destroy.
Last a week a prominent Pittsburgh Republican, Mike Embrescia, changed his mind and became a Democrat. This was a great conversation about why. Mike was the lone Republican on Allegheny County Council and chair of the GOP in my town, so this was a major, life-changing move. His courage and honesty are impressive, and a good reminder that we should never give up making our case. There are people out there ready to listen.

name: TPUSA Faith
subject: The gift of gathering
body:
Gathering together is a real gift, and August showed us why.
| [ ](https://d1K2-504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DN+113/d1K2-504/VVR5hG2-yTvrW21HbQg2ggYYnW4Rs6st5VmTKfN46-8Kb3qn9qW8wLKSR6lZ3mzW8B6l5j2x4P7xW1_zZ4T8Y-cfvW5Bsf5s1yJsYBW4NN89842C1YJW8ZYzWM82NT6lW7ylyqp3TZGJvW2xdS2Y7FzK56W3L88qQ6K_kylW6Zj8-L75cNxhW1FbX6s59ZhC5W4_jDYJ4HpKGRW5C5K_v445CqZW6SzvY_3-PHPFW1rvXXQ4HgfLmW6H8fwN4tnznRW6RGZ5j61VfP3W3C5M364d87HBW8lMZXF1_WvPyW6HwwkV5LDdbxW3zH2Q778m-b7W4-PzQp7sTPKcW692WYn4nXSySW3vb5n9529dqQW6x6sdf6C4vJwV-ySvR5nFrvBW4Zh7-K1zm--qW7gcSNm8Y6cmZW2LBPD02jhX8sf4d6cP804)
---
Dear Peter,
---
August reminded us of the gift of gathering as the body of Christ. Hebrews 10:24-25 calls us to "stir up one another to love and good works" and to encourage one another in the faith. Throughout the month, we saw biblical fellowship firsthand as pastors gathered for our Faith Forward Pastors Summit and believers filled our Make Heaven Crowded Tour stops across the country. There is something powerful about believers spurring one another on as we live out the Gospel.
---
|
---
### Faith Forward Pastor’s Summit: Santa Barbara
---
---
Away from the busyness of everyday ministry, pastors had the opportunity to rest and be sharpened at our Faith Forward Pastor’s Summit in Santa Barbara. Throughout the Summit, Pastor Lucas Miles, along with Erika Kirk, Greg Laurie, Ruslan, Andrew Sedra, Eric Metaxas, and many other wonderful leaders, hosted and poured into the pastors gathered there. Each brought timely insight to help pastors lead with greater clarity and better serve the communities entrusted to them.
---
---
---
At the heart of these conversations was a shared conviction: the freedom we have to share the Gospel is a gift worth stewarding and protecting. Not because the Gospel depends on our freedoms, but because our freedoms give us an extraordinary opportunity to proclaim Christ openly. Whatever the cultural or political landscape may hold, the Church's calling remains unchanged, and our pastors remain strengthened in their resolve to faithfully proclaim Christ in every circumstance.

Watch Pastor Greg Laurie's full message, along with other sessions from the Summit!
---
[ ](https://d1K2-504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DN+113/d1K2-504/VVR5hG2-yTvrW21HbQg2ggYYnW4Rs6st5VmTKfN46-8JW5nXHCW7Y9pgv6lZ3p0W8s2Qcp3QkYbvW3rtgrx3t3PskW7PN14-7k8B_LW1qrLkQ1zFLZXN7Nrw55qc9LtVsPCJ91St6SSW8SKCVm8ZLHXCV9xKPj8wPLBVW8Bxv2f250Yg5W6hbMxg6H1NB2W5VslGt6kW--JW7D8yx26ZH49YW2C6RXC36FS0cM_wfr5cbRM0W1v-gKc5nMZ0HN16JXXZQ-y0fW2vPXX_9b3w0fN88stxZD2dqfN7Z2775lGjl3W2S1cCm6ZwDZxW6xYgPl93xHzfW3czdXK96QdR6W8N8XTq4xDNQlW1syXCV6cmy5LW2G31gS52RcXqW6jq9XY8NsTWGW7lZFnC69gVPZW6ghFRP9kFhMMW1GDtkk4yW1GVW291Rn46xdzL4VZxNZl94x6lqW7ZPYnW3b6bcgW9cdtTL8PCxr5W2Yh_tb2MJKn2W11D08W4CyPRxW8Q0QPM2FKff6W4ncYS68Qx_VdW5C-_Kk5MpRxCW60d4Fy3QklM1N6RkKvD-mLWxW22xF_J3l8tNNW82YNyz84YXvDf7XHQy604)
---
|
---
### Make Heaven Crowded
---
---
---
Make Heaven Crowded was continuing on the road through August in Phoenix, Arizona, and El Paso, Texas. We had the honor of hosting Willie Robertson, who shared how his family’s story of faith began with one person willing to share the Gospel with his father, Phil. One act of obedience to the Great Commission changed this family's trajectory and ultimately reached countless others. Our stories of faith are all woven together, each tracing back to someone who chose to tell someone else about Jesus. Be that person. Share the Gospel. And Make Heaven Crowded!
---
[ ](https://d1K2-504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DN+113/d1K2-504/VVR5hG2-yTvrW21HbQg2ggYYnW4Rs6st5VmTKfN46-8JW5nXHCW7Y9pgv6lZ3kzW22gkMh8Z-VRTW15gH5175QL62Vymx2S6rX7ZBW1gVC342-MW2zW3G6Yn910CcgdVvD14N9m0N4FN8-M9KK7nl5jW89fLv34VK1YLW4dPLJv57GRH8W4QV54y38k8vSN7WmJcxKHrjYW1f_jhw44QgSdW344nGh7qM2JNW79sNJW5xtCWkN2TfT_2DDVK-W8twwRP3QgKg4W4SZCjB3RgGX1W4pSd8H2b_yTKW7RMbHB3kq-QFW5mc8MR3vR_lhW7F0z7s1tgj-VW24xJ0K5jgYYfW3RLcQ91BnyMgW9gX0Cs7VXQBWW5VBWtc24RHj4W5XX8dH90kwV3W5kV35-4_kcmRW6CY_z46lVld1W4RgyBq5wqqmSW9m4FQd69F78HW5YW-2-20GFLdW6J1H-V3TVym0W5-2jzy4Fpr1xW78x6h03gVJ3lVR37zV5RKm3KW444q5t80Qr9BW3D_PS43PNnk0W7q2qKv8PMn7tW6lpNBs1bx8STVW1ZGq1GKPz3W85QpBz4fp3GbN2PKCGqPwcYMf2b_4-C04)

clean_body: Gathering together is a real gift, and August showed us why. | Dear Peter, August reminded us of the gift of gathering as the body of Christ. Hebrews 10:24-25 calls us to "stir up one another to love and good works" and to encourage one another in the faith. Throughout the month, we saw biblical fellowship firsthand as pastors gathered for our Faith Forward Pastors Summit and believers filled our Make Heaven Crowded Tour stops across the country. There is something powerful about believers spurring one another on as we live out the Gospel. | Faith Forward Pastor’s Summit: Santa Barbara Away from the busyness of everyday ministry, pastors had the opportunity to rest and be sharpened at our Faith Forward Pastor’s Summit in Santa Barbara. Throughout the Summit, Pastor Lucas Miles, along with Erika Kirk, Greg Laurie, Ruslan, Andrew Sedra, Eric Metaxas, and many other wonderful leaders, hosted and poured into the pastors gathered there. Each brought timely insight to help pastors lead with greater clarity and better serve the communities entrusted to them. At the heart of these conversations was a shared conviction: the freedom we have to share the Gospel is a gift worth stewarding and protecting. Not because the Gospel depends on our freedoms, but because our freedoms give us an extraordinary opportunity to proclaim Christ openly. Whatever the cultural or political landscape may hold, the Church's calling remains unchanged, and our pastors remain strengthened in their resolve to faithfully proclaim Christ in every circumstance. Watch Pastor Greg Laurie's full message, along with other sessions from the Summit! | Make Heaven Crowded Make Heaven Crowded was continuing on the road through August in Phoenix, Arizona, and El Paso, Texas. We had the honor of hosting Willie Robertson, who shared how his family’s story of faith began with one person willing to share the Gospel with his father, Phil. One act of obedience to the Great Commission changed this family's trajectory and ultimately reached countless others. # MOORE LEAVES MARYLAND BEHIND, REACTS TO OUR LEADERSHIP.
Friend, The November 3 election is weeks away, and we need your help now. We called out Wes Moore for fast-tracking a massive TeraWulf data center at a Maryland power plant after TeraWulf’s owner gave $24,000 to Moore and Miller’s campaigns. Moore then announced a data center executive order that gives him more power over these deals, including projects he has already approved. We also challenged him on Maryland’s second-worst economy and the nation’s highest electric bills. Now he is running a TV ad claiming to fight grocery price gouging, while his 338 new taxes and fees, energy policies, and rising electric bills burden families and leave Maryland facing a $3.3 billion structural deficit. Moore still has not rebuilt the Key Bridge or addressed 1,100 Maryland bridges needing repair. Yet he wants to take on grocery prices while his policies drive up costs and shutter power plants, including Morgantown, which is being turned into a mega data center. [Help us raise $100,000 now for new TV commercials.](https://us.list-manage.com/lmVhNDKgQwu?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) A gift of $176 covers one 30-second spot; [$1,776 covers ten.](https://us.list-manage.com/XwhY1sNeAZk?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) Thank you for helping us fight for a more affordable, safer Maryland. Together, we will win.
For Maryland,
Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor

## Trump Hosts Xi, Extends Tariff Truce
President Trump [welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdD6ZBey4cJGG7tKmRNZ5OW9kMLIXuPv7iPxCupFG8zQz3_fp7inR-vzyCzqe87TiWRMyY5le5JkjnpEYY94rRl8OrLxMoEBLZSUMk38wHTj1vgluRgTsGnStsarrlGlNE52BWfnB9mDs0JoAoLUCa9F2aEPo24bcxVMWhlapodU37EAHNfetf8BHQC16hYE4l9tPppUjzumdDyy3R16a5CLzVkX3KWAUMK7vLVe-LAHjBRYwKnvpXsC4V3ktFDC-SC6IXOVJHCWXfdlk2AutT7lXeVAllokOlPsWPOMVaYoL20kpUdVG9Oq5eEp_Jfif3x0OfgMAAP__222DHw) to the White House Thursday with a red carpet and a military flyover, the first Chinese state visit to the United States since 2015. A state dinner followed Thursday night. The two sides [extended their trade truce](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULFuhDAU-5qwBYVHIMeQoQvbde2IcvByeVVITvCOXP--olLVD-hkWbIt2x_X6eooUrq_uxUt-zwlLHtEZtymFznmgCUQY8jPHYPbDtx5nUBBL9UgoZvczHTgpF21WI8I2FZoGzOotlWmMVWwc2caBRd_u7nFD6YH73QHXjvs_HDpTUX2zFMDdI1SXdPX2EK_KK8bN8NlwV5ohQtx3urPTIkD-viVD9zqOa9VtIH5sYv2TcAoYCyl1Ok2F7cHSnfO6VQJGM9hJzimnFyUlBi3XyZgnAMlJ18kD9qJ5Z9f8vZcH7JgnPOKAkbddGYYtICx2uzyKBQj7b0RWt1XR_GnFf_zzMPCdwAAAP___uGMdw) through Jan. 10, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said, with both agreeing to hold off on new restrictions. The short window is meant to test whether Beijing delivers on farm purchases and critical mineral exports. The leaders ignored shouted questions about fentanyl, AI, and jailed Hong Kong publisher Jimmy Lai. Trump showed Xi his new granite helipad and took him up in Marine One, saying the Chinese leader "loves good granite." Outside, protesters wore Winnie the Pooh costumes, a jab at a likeness comparison Chinese censors have spent years scrubbing.
## OpenAI Agent Hacked Australian Portal
Australia says a rogue OpenAI model [hacked a government health portal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOwwgihQUf2M3f7uluaPXgV2QCdzRnbffuK-w3UlOcnK-7-M23yDEsD_-Q0JHW553PGtEIizzdwAij6cPhD6_KnooB1ZKsxJq4MJy1c-wUDhw1tCsbkNU2DXopLGi64SRpvHOjvo-WGM1ylFuxvTW6E5uBiSCHO9jE9y1J6zqpRC9HFrs1LCKTUtY1LjiwLTANVAu7WcOO3nc4jsfWNolpyY6T_SsrPvH1MTUdJ5nu9zrxXH1TE1XZGqCV6UCMQDPT9wh8JIfL-Qprxi5h-WLe4RIfoGCvL4rYeIVEodICXampqa49XmGGEMdDNPikSDE3w_0R3WHUz8BAAD__4MGhfk) in June, and Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Wednesday the company waited far too long to disclose it. No personal information was accessed. The agent was searching for data on government medicine spending during an internal test. Denied access, it went around the restriction. Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles said it "[scaled the fence](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAURJ8GOq_873XhIs12X9qU6GIua0cGI_vCJnn6iLxCytFIoznnx9f0Bbnk_f0dNgy01mnHTy9IhG36lYEo4SdlwlTPjgnahZ22SXJpGfdMmgki5QsnDeMSVkSJasQgnOdKcSfcmAI3XmthZgvKPr3mChWAfXr71LOeTRxzuPe4l0ZwboR9oJJ24asWEOVzQTtojkum2h4_a94p4Vp-1wvbI9ZtLCERHX1Q3wb5GuQLjhvhru7QKMeCg3zVA3fI7NzhpFRb_oMLgxixdwZnpwYlA4NCG-wMygw7dmTCOXQIq7BxdVp5xYF7rY30fnFOmbGF5fjkUnK3btD8vUEu_17Rf8q8gvwbAAD__7-uiTo)." OpenAI spotted the activity in August and emailed a generic government inbox on Sept. 10. | | Friends,
We got great news as Michiganders are starting to vote: The Detroit News has endorsed our campaign!
[You can read the whole piece here](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ImsZf2FSeoNUPhW239wJQpifHJRv84pcWblT801bsle2IpM4_Gqw2bgSSIc4in1QGtok2sUEFMRp6FUT7JaMhxX_80fI-wLhc_R4eGMx1tG1ifQjA0bkWeSFUgiIe34868T_ofaeF2FfJg0ZLtbsaEn8N6gFBWZ8hNvhaxHIcZdFv4qn-dhweipjRSXmnYc0Bf5BDlJ-mW6TzT4_z7Ev5OK3DAFi31Ivnl1RoMrPjLAIF5XJ2Y50Sxi8vwLeHzXUfwM_sLEuWaEd4-X5OXJ8SnQPBTFAhnpjVUp_yBXDUs04blCzvsRQ6Q==&c=5FuRTjclYD3DGOo2_k5NrnwExbcHR-JKzqPL0oAZr6i5mgbc1T9YpA==&ch=HoPVGDAyP2oTiNU_SjTiCuXvGb_H0RKVTktXyVQHBuVQDo9KtMmZkQ==), but I want to share parts of what they said about this race:
In the race for Michigan's next attorney general, voters should look past party politics -- of which there are plenty this midterm cycle -- and directly to which candidate, Eli Savit or Doug Lloyd, can be trusted with the enormous power of the office.
There is a striking contrast between the two.
The record for Savit, the Washtenaw County prosecutor and Democratic nominee, suggests he sees a prosecutor not just as an enforcer of the law but as someone empowered to decide which laws to enforce. It's a troubling enough philosophy in one county. But it could be dangerous in Michigan's top law enforcement office. ...
[Doug Lloyd's] record includes the prosecution of murder, rape, armed robbery, drug trafficking and economic crimes. He has served as president of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan and on state boards dealing with retail fraud and drug-treatment courts.
He was nominated by then-Gov. Rick Snyder to serve on the Organized Retail Crime Advisory Board in 2013 and was subsequently reappointed by Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
He has spent his career doing the ordinary, essential work of prosecution. That means applying laws, building cases, protecting victims and exercising judgment within the boundaries of the office.
The Detroit News editorial board joins nearly [every business organization across Michigan](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ImsZf2FSeoNUPhW239wJQpifHJRv84pcWblT801bsle2IpM4_Gqw2bgSSIc4in1Q7gpK05SfdozVUZ8-p_4u4oid-RMFLvNT5lc5y4abxBvoK1LRLtmNRKKDJFhbYICcSOJJ_f8oX2w2SAWweNxlGNWUZCUBliSSV8P1-AoH_p7eXNmKRY3FWfzsm7dFCR-Z&c=5FuRTjclYD3DGOo2_k5NrnwExbcHR-JKzqPL0oAZr6i5mgbc1T9YpA==&ch=HoPVGDAyP2oTiNU_SjTiCuXvGb_H0RKVTktXyVQHBuVQDo9KtMmZkQ==), the Police Officers Association of Michigan, the Michigan Fraternal Order of Police, the Michigan Association of Police, more than 60 county prosecutors, and over 30 sheriffs in supporting me to be the next Attorney General.
And the timing couldn't have been better.
Michiganders are able to vote right now. I hope you'll get your vote in quickly and do everything possible to help us win in these final weeks.

Garces Perez's attorney, Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch, says he was making a DoorDash delivery when an unmarked truck sideswiped his car, and agents shot him. ICE says there was a foot chase. Police video [appears to show](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ8GOiOzNgYKF2noLm1KtAcLWDL2yV7gLk8fcXmEvx19M5qZP4_xgc67sP7GnSy_lzgGurInZkrjsfrPFo9MOU-475QyBaYw0QgSjJC9gGbEid1Jo8Zytk8593VJtm57qZRWHZSbrVtlngqoWaQhqE23gK67ucfGzIvRunT2jpM9NHUtlTQVgsEWe1y6DrUiVWhJs-OYKt6I6Y158Z94UqqmuJfebsyvXKhfBQwFDNd1VUt8t3hkduFGChjuVQUM_zXhJhJ5i5FdWEWil1gTrWLCjEmcLjvO4qRAfw_yGMSO4ab5a8OVApfJzq_Lee-yaQst1x2d_5bhn554WvgXAAD__5a4iow) a pursuit before the shooting.
## DNA Identifies Missing Texas State Student
DNA testing has [identified skeletal remains](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL8GZ4xwY2McEFzibC-90OqBZswdxivoGe_8_cn7CxtWlfRUVX8-1g9MOZXHb9zJ8Vc81kJny8RMdX0-8ns7no1a87jvVBsVpuJpBQVGqlnCuKLn9KJ1wC64uwpz35Hrp1lpPWgL3eZMNOT9ZIxSEfqRglVGjz5AtPexD9Qld-HUDGPfK63MDcHghDNGa3HQpMWgKCQ-6o03YvrCFvP7eFG9-WPvstuYP5vQvwQsApbzPG__qLTxSgUsWDn5TAKWa5qAxde0X3JPraXykN9E2RiZZONnoMLyL7ajyIwl1LdMl5VioiBggUlL2yuPISoZwA9yMPYuZ28nacH6fpjG0avYVRc-z5RzamYSg3rsmPJ3Yf7p0S8H_wMAAP__L1GS1Q) found near Luling as Jason Landry, the 21-year-old Texas State University student who vanished nearly six years ago while driving home for Christmas. Landry was driving from San Marcos to Missouri City on Dec. 13, 2020, when he [wrecked his Nissan Altima](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQBdCvwR0RHogdCopt3L1tt7QmZohZYRwxk7z471d-v7DdSCMd3Xv_fM1fmEuuj9-4UZBP2udK31xIhNr8epRj3V9MzAtuGzWmKlQXmsHAoI3XcJ1xkfym2WEXw91E33cU-tEba529QbeG3qURTW_cjRIke1-uy70H07txWHzy1y6HkzMern1vrBkuCAOO6DHdbugsWeUMxSx7u8hKQh_kVI79Te2y7FtXwiryZGV_KZgUTPV47iznS8F0ygom48_bKZherM-GCqYfSLOgkGZ5Raqi_yLvVRessR260Ya5ss4x6krYyqE5f_RB2FhjEmp6Jf3GmnmlqGDqWojP71xK5mFUzjw2zOUno_zvtu8A_wIAAP__lH6QNA) on a rural road outside Luling. Searchers found his phone and wallet inside the car and his clothing scattered nearby, but no sign of him. A man clearing land near the crash site [spotted what he took for a ball](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAURp8Gd4zggv8KijR0mzaldQ3XNgmGFeDxzttHs3mE1J--I53z62P5wBBD2n_iSaZ9bXlJdNdIrVFZrj2-jnxVqtXheVKplBolRwsIGLiYOfQLuhaetGjsvFmFn2VHRo6zUEqrCbrDjKsGAbSOM0pNs6QVxeSHXg5K6G2ELpg3TszQSymUGB4IA4444zZNqBUppgX50HJ5tIMafWHd4is_qTxcPrtojtY-K1M_GFgG9r7vx58jX--RgcXSgovEwL7NGNiYHUYG9hvEz1BrSDsD-xtrTjxi8uXFC50YUuVbvpLn8Xo34v8enrAdPKQn1RZ2bCEnBhamnjuFTrh-5L2bJ65x9XwaYePaSfTSy02roSvGf94hxlCHkWmxnxjit0f73_5PA38DAAD__9tPm4o) on Sept. 8, then realized it was a human skull. Investigators say the remains reveal nothing about how Landry died and no sign of foul play.
## 'Ugly Houses' Franchisee Gets 15 Years
A Dallas real estate executive who used the "We Buy Ugly Houses" brand to defraud more than 80 investors of nearly $40 million was [sentenced Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQBuCnsTcsfBDbDAxdsqVrR-tijhgJmwgucfL2Fa36BN1OutP9-v6vy3zBEMN--8SNLL98mnc6SiRmyvPjFt9rehQqZcFto1xoZ9oXmkHCIKQRcJpx4fCkWWPr7FU607dk-9FIpbSaoF2tmZwHOTok7XFcCCYDQG65egODg6kNtr6TBk59L5UcOoQBRzTopwm1ItVoSS5wyh2vxPTC4uM7PSl3S9raaFfme2nURwPnBs7HcXQ-vXSF1IMGznWsGxLXx1tUlvh1iUwYBRVGJuFD3sQf0QlPjjJGcc-hpL3N1t2PEGMow9hoedswxJ98_m9vTwvfAQAA___KiYbE) to 188 months in federal prison. From 2018 through 2024, Charles Carrier, 67, told investors that their money would [buy and renovate specific homes](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1urDAQBeCngW5Wxua3cHEbur1tSjRrjxdLBq_sgYW3j0iUvEDqGR2d73zcpzv64Nfnf1xI8-HitNI7B2KmNG3PcM5xy5SzwWWhlGllWg1NUsgWxACymdCw32mqsbT6IexQlaSrbhBK1aqX5axRWTlUTlDb94PslEPpqsb0ousercO29PqKE4Nsqkoo0d5QttjhgK7vsVakilqQ9RzTjWdiOjC7cMad0s3EpQx6Zn7lQv0r5FjI0WIImOl4Jcr5-ijkaDyfvyd4Ezy2Ey4efPuADjLbBYEfowWOsMREwDOuUDVwEqYMLibw606ZYwKXcLOFHMuk7evtQ_C57YpaPBf04asd_3XVXcvPAAAA__9dOJC-) and that their loans would hold the first claim on those properties. Often, he never filed the paperwork. Carrier [pledged the same houses](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-upSAQx_GnwQ4DA_4rKLaxu9tuaUYZjmxQDODx-PYbd7NPcOtf8s185tfX9IU--P31Ezcy5ePitNOVA5VCaTpf4V7jmSnnBbeNUqa90L7QBAJaLgYOzYRL8W-aNFbWzMIOsiIju0EopVUP1Wo0kZ1Jzq3EWTQNNCha10gtZ-kUCKi8eXJigEZKoURbI7TY4YCu71ErUkwLsr7EVJeVCn0wu3DHN6V6iVsVzFrKkZn6wWBkMF7XVe_zYt31zAzGR8RgDHHB8OzE5_PmD47_0_EjUfaW9sL_Cy0vkTuylDDwI_kcd-5i4i7haXleVtqI2_ibZ7yfuBY9iG5gMFbJ2OPyIfjcdkyL14Y-_D20fPfBbwN_AgAA___Qs5Lf) to multiple lenders, sold properties without telling the investors who funded them, and forged lien releases to close those sales, prosecutors said. He spent the money on personal expenses and payouts to earlier investors. Carrier [pleaded guilty to wire fraud](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GuzvBq6IUFNvYzbZbmqtelARhAowzvv3G3Uf46y85-c7585ye5LwL22862JSvjVPgT_ZcCqfpvflrj-_MOS90HJwyh8Jh4QklKpAasJtoKe7kqaVqNbNcdV2xqXstm6ZtBqx2o9SgsbOd7ZWaZxzWTs0WubOsLdFcV87cOKmxq2vZSPUgVNSTJjsM1DbciFby6kpMj7Jz4S9l6694cnos8ai82Ut5ZdH8EjgKHPcYV-8C36PA8WYLHKUWOK7kPWX4MMzvC249-O8HNlFYdpeZYeOSoe7gYkoZbEzQygNcODmXmOBOIXCskllfH-e9y6oXrdwOcv7fn_LTjqfBvwEAAP__V8GJTw) in October 2025 and owes $24,416,911 in restitution. He "preyed on Main Street families, retirees and small business owners," U.S. Attorney Ryan Raybould said.

body:

We fell short of our mid-month fundraising goal last week, and we’re looking at having to make budget cuts just 39 days out from the election.
[**_If you’re able to chip in $5 or even just a few bucks today, that would be a huge help. Far-right groups are pouring millions into this race to defeat me. President Trump and JD Vance both came to North Carolina to rally alongside their handpicked candidate, Michael Whatley. The attacks are turning the tides against us, one baseless ad and Truth Social attack at a time.
Most alarming of all, _two_ recent polls of likely voters now show this race statistically tied.

Roy Cooper

Hey friends,
This is one of the most important conversations we've had on this show.
[**[Click Here to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/QHOixoNJTf3?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
****
[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/Luwm_BCicwM?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

This week I sat down with Lisa Sherman-Luna, executive director of[ TIRRC Votes](https://us.list-manage.com/1B5nd16lvUu?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), to talk about what's actually happening with immigration enforcement in Tennessee right now. Lisa shares her own family's story of fleeing Guatemala after her sister was kidnapped, and we get into last year's fight to protect every child's right to a public education, the real economic case for immigration, and the expansion of 287(g) agreements that are putting local tax dollars toward federal immigration enforcement.
This conversation covers some difficult ground, including real stories about detention and family separation, but it's exactly the kind of honest reporting I think Tennesseans deserve right now.

[**[Click to hear the pod and LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/161T58_uwNF?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)

Thank you for being here,
Gloria

Peter, There is a moment before a jump where the door is open, the wind is so loud you can't hear the man next to you, and you are standing there with eighty pounds strapped to your body waiting on a green light.
I did that for the 82nd Airborne. Then the 101st. Then I spent nine months in Baghdad. You would think a man who has stood in that door a few hundred times wouldn't get nervous about much of anything.
I thought so too.
Then my team sat me down this week and showed me _**where we stand going into September 30th.**_

**_Let me explain._**
This is Mike Bouchard. Captain, United States Army, and the Republican nominee for Michigan's 10th District.
**I 'll be honest with you — campaigning is harder than jumping out of airplanes.** Out there I knew exactly what my job was. Here, some days it feels like the weight of this whole district is sitting on my shoulders.
Because the Democrats have decided Michigan's 10th is how they take back the House. _**Not a seat in California. Not New York. Ours.**_
My opponent spent nearly every dollar she raised getting through her primary. That means Washington is about to write her a very large check - and Washington's money always comes with Washington's strings attached. _**September 30th is our End-of-Quarter deadline.**_
This isn't just an arbitrary date. It's the LAST end-of-quarter deadline of this campaign. Every deadline I've ever asked you about had another one behind it. This one doesn't. After the 30th there is no next quarter - there's just the election.
What we raise in the next few days pays for the _**door-knockers in Sterling Heights,**_ the yard signs across Macomb, and the ads that reach the folks in this district who haven't made up their minds yet.
I'm not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets.
_**All I'm asking is a $1 or more donation, which goes straight into this campaign and helps us hold Michigan's 10th in November.**_
**As a combat veteran — and as a guy whose grandfather worked thirty-three years at the GM plant in Warren — I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I am grateful for ANY gift you can make.**
**Please donate below! ⬇️**

clean_body: They're about to spend millions to take this seat| | | Peter, There is a moment before a jump where the door is open, the wind is so loud you can't hear the man next to you, and you are standing there with eighty pounds strapped to your body waiting on a green light. I did that for the 82nd Airborne. Then the 101st. Then I spent nine months in Baghdad. You would think a man who has stood in that door a few hundred times wouldn't get nervous about much of anything. I thought so too. Then my team sat me down this week and showed me where we stand going into September 30th. Let me explain. This is Mike Bouchard. Captain, United States Army, and the Republican nominee for Michigan's 10th District. I 'll be honest with you — campaigning is harder than jumping out of airplanes. Out there I knew exactly what my job was. Here, some days it feels like the weight of this whole district is sitting on my shoulders. Because the Democrats have decided Michigan's 10th is how they take back the House. Not a seat in California. Not New York. Ours. My opponent spent nearly every dollar she raised getting through her primary. That means Washington is about to write her a very large check - and Washington's money always comes with Washington's strings attached. September 30th is our End-of-Quarter deadline. This isn't just an arbitrary date. It's the LAST end-of-quarter deadline of this campaign. Every deadline I've ever asked you about had another one behind it. This one doesn't. After the 30th there is no next quarter - there's just the election. What we raise in the next few days pays for the door-knockers in Sterling Heights, the yard signs across Macomb, and the ads that reach the folks in this district who haven't made up their minds yet. I'm not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I'm asking is a $1 or more donation, which goes straight into this campaign and helps us hold Michigan's 10th in November. As a combat veteran — and as a guy whose grandfather worked thirty-three years at the GM plant in Warren — I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I am grateful for ANY gift you can make. Please donate below! ⬇️ | - Time is running out. Thank you for reading this far, and I hope I can count on your help. Hi friend, it’s Denise, Deb’s oldest sister.
I’ve watched Deb grow into a strong, capable, and resilient woman over the years. She has always had her own way of doing things, regardless of the status quo. She has always stood strong in her beliefs and worked hard to help those who struggle find their voice. **_That’s just who Deb is._

** I am incredibly proud that she is my sister. Watching her connect with New Mexicans, and with so many people beyond our state, has been amazing. So many people have put their faith in her and stood by her because they truly believe in her. They see what I have always known: **Deb is the real deal.** I have no doubt that she will work as hard as she possibly can for the people of New Mexico. She will listen, she will stand up for those who need a voice, and she will fight for what she believes is right.

**[_That’s why I wanted to personally reach out and ask: Will you chip in $5 today to help elect my sister, Deb, as New Mexico’s next governor?_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16412?refcode=jtk1446-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12704%2E400544%2ESc8FXE)**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16411?refcode=jtk1446-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12704%2E400544%2ESc8FXE)

Friend, I’ve watched Deb do some incredible things over the years, from serving in Congress to leading the Department of the Interior and now running for Governor of New Mexico. I’m proud of everything she’s accomplished, but the titles aren’t what make me proudest to call her my sister.

_What makes me proudest is seeing how people respond to her._ The smiles, the hugs, the thank yous, and the encouragement she gets from strangers never fails to amaze me. It never fails when I wear my DEB FOR GOVERNOR T-shirt. People, not just from New Mexico but from all over, will stop me and say, “I love your shirt!”
**There is a vibe.
**
People believe in Deb. And they believe in her because they know she genuinely cares.
Deb always shows up for the people she loves. She baked both my wedding cake and our other sister Zoe’s wedding cake! She has made countless treats and dishes for family celebrations and always found a way to make our family events special. **When Deb cares about someone, she shows up. When she believes something is right, she stands up for it. When she believes something is wrong, she calls it out.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16411?refcode=jtk1446-fr-nd&t=5&akid=12704%2E400544%2ESc8FXE)
_And after everything she has accomplished, that part of Deb has never changed._
No doubt, this campaign is going to be tough and challenging. But there is also no doubt in my mind that, with your help, she can accomplish her goal of becoming our next Governor.**[_So please, I’m asking you to stand with my sister and pitch in $5 or anything you can today. Election Day is coming fast, and your support will help make sure Deb has what she needs to win this race._](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16411?refcode=jtk1446-fr-nd&t=6&akid=12704%2E400544%2ESc8FXE)**

| | Dear Fellow American, This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited. The signers of that document pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor in its defense. The Declaration’s principles are the foundation of our Constitution, which was signed 239 years ago on September 17, 1787. **But today, many of our fellow citizens reject the principles of the Declaration and seek a radical transformation of the Constitution—putting the liberty of all Americans at risk.** This means there is much work to be done on the battlefield of education. And that’s why your support is urgently needed. [I hope you’ll join 500 fellow Americans in defending the principles of the Declaration and the Constitution by becoming a **_Liberty & Learning Society_** member.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2L3DAMhn-Nc0tw7Hw4hxyGzaQUOv1gDj0a1dJkRB07xM6W_fclsAs996pXPEjP-_Nmb8Cew_IVVho5JYsRbTx2F0PKnI_MMXCCvHP6bZVUXSmHUrUWXOZXsg0UOLaqNg9T0Fj3g9S6N7IrnmPbDZ1TcuixoebhEFTbkEOAnsCYGgseT54cVFsrqZWuADoCo5EM0MPQL9HIY0PIVHFIjJRcjNsWPWd2qYr7UvjxmfOWhL4INQs1J3LHTtWTvU8InirCQ6gZY4BMQs3_flUivJXnBULPiZaVQn6JSEJPUte1uUg5v9yun6Zv0_V6F6o78mrTaeZc2faYNnKZw_IerYR8rEJPtAL796GDdQNegtCTi8EivH0EMWQKWejpy_dLbX_05ef7vfzwUewjbn_Ye05dLxq5nMjKxbXI_9fR66j-BgAA__9IMaM3) And when you join the **_Liberty & Learning Society_** with a monthly gift of $18.44 or more, I’ll send you a leather-bound edition of _The U.S. Constitution: A Reader_ —published by Hillsdale College and used by our students—as a special thank-you for your support. America’s Founders understood that liberty cannot endure without a citizenry educated in the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. This is the kind of education Hillsdale provides—and it is needed more urgently than ever. **If liberty is to endure for the next 250 years, we must teach future generations about the principles that make it possible.** [You can help by joining the **_Liberty & Learning Society_** today.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2L3DAMhn-Nc0tw7Hw4hxyGzaQUOv1gDj0a1dJkRB07xM6W_fclsAs996pXPEjP-_Nmb8Cew_IVVho5JYsRbTx2F0PKnI_MMXCCvHP6bZVUXSmHUrUWXOZXsg0UOLaqNg9T0Fj3g9S6N7IrnmPbDZ1TcuixoebhEFTbkEOAnsCYGgseT54cVFsrqZWuADoCo5EM0MPQL9HIY0PIVHFIjJRcjNsWPWd2qYr7UvjxmfOWhL4INQs1J3LHTtWTvU8InirCQ6gZY4BMQs3_flUivJXnBULPiZaVQn6JSEJPUte1uUg5v9yun6Zv0_V6F6o78mrTaeZc2faYNnKZw_IerYR8rEJPtAL796GDdQNegtCTi8EivH0EMWQKWejpy_dLbX_05ef7vfzwUewjbn_Ye05dLxq5nMjKxbXI_9fR66j-BgAA__9IMaM3) I hope you’ll stand with Hillsdale College as we defend the principles of liberty in America’s 250th anniversary year. Warm regards,Larry P. Arnn

name: Congressman Chris Deluzio
subject: The Washington Post
body:
[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=107%2E42639%2EYq0aya ]Chris Deluzio for PA

Over the past few weeks, there's been a lot of speculation about whether
or not I will run for the Senate seat in 2028 that John Fetterman
currently holds. It's getting to the point where I am being asked about it
in almost every interview and I get it.

But let me say this. We are just about six weeks away from the most
consequential midterm election in quite some time. At stake is nothing
less than whether or not we are going to take back the House and Senate
and put a check on the most dangerous president in modern American
history.

For me, I have my own House race and as the last Democrat in Pennsylvania
who represents a battleground seat, I am taking that seriously

So I've attached a recent Washington Post article below. File it away.
Remmeber it. We'll come back to it. But please help me in my race if you
can:

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/deluzio-em-26-q3?refcode=em260925&refcode2=107_42639_Yq0aya&akid=107%2E42639%2EYq0aya ]DONATE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/deluzio-em-26-q3?refcode=em260925&refcode2=107_42639_Yq0aya&akid=107%2E42639%2EYq0aya ]Washington post logo

Fetterman appears by video at GOP convention, sparking Democratic backlash

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/deluzio-em-26-q3?refcode=em260925&refcode2=107_42639_Yq0aya&akid=107%2E42639%2EYq0aya ]Fetterman at the Republican Convention

Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pennsylvania) made an unusual surprise appearance
by video Wednesday at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas,
praising Sen. Dave McCormick (R-Pennsylvania) and expressing willingness
to work with President Donald Trump.

The video was the latest instance of Fetterman lauding Republicans. That
praise, coupled with his frequent criticism of his own party, has stoked
speculation that he could become a Republican.

Fetterman described himself during his remarks at the convention as a
“common-sense Democrat” who rejected socialism and “extremes.” He lauded
McCormick as his “great friend” and “a great senator” even though the two
belong to different parties.

“We’ll work together and we’ll work with President Trump to fight and
defend the steel way right here in the Steel Valley,” Fetterman said in
the video, standing in front of the U.S. Steel plant in Braddock,
Pennsylvania, where Fetterman once served as mayor.

In a statement after his remarks, Fetterman said he would not switch
parties even if Democrats retake the Senate in the midterm elections. If
Democrats pick up four seats, they would control the Senate 51-49, giving
Fetterman the power to return control of the chamber to Republicans if he
switched parties.

“I’m a lifelong Democrat who votes overwhelmingly with my party — and
should the Senate flip in November, I will still be the 51st vote that I
ran on,” Fetterman said in the statement.

It is uncommon but not unprecedented for lawmakers to appear at the
opposite party’s convention.

Sen. Zell Miller (D-Georgia) spoke at the Republican National Convention
in 2004. Sen. Joe Lieberman of Connecticut, a onetime Democratic
vice-presidential nominee, spoke at the Republican convention in 2008 on
behalf of his friend, Sen. John McCain. And former congressman Adam
Kinzinger (R-Illinois) spoke at the Democratic National Convention in
2024, though he had left office by the time he appeared.

Fetterman and McCormick have forged a close relationship since McCormick’s
election in 2024. They appeared together last year at the Edward Kennedy
Institute in Boston to celebrate bipartisanship, and they have made public
appearances together in recent weeks in Pennsylvania.

McCormick returned Fetterman’s praise Wednesday at the convention, drawing
cheers from the crowd.

“How great is John Fetterman, right?” McCormick said after the video
played. “Thank you Senator Fetterman for your friendship, thank you for
your courage and thank you for all you do for Pennsylvania.”

Fetterman’s appearances on Fox News and pointed criticism of Democrats
have helped make him popular with Republicans, even as he has mostly
continued to vote with Democrats in the Senate.

Seventy-nine percent of Republicans in Pennsylvania have a favorable
opinion of Fetterman, according to a New York Times/Philadelphia
Inquirer/Siena College poll conducted last month. That’s higher than the
share of Republicans who have a favorable view of McCormick, who almost
always votes with his party.

Only 21 percent of Democrats hold a favorable opinion of Fetterman, and 67
percent hold an unfavorable opinion.

Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-New York) has praised Fetterman,
describing him as “a very good member of Congress.”

“The people in our caucus very much like and respect him,” Schumer told
reporters in July. “We’re a big-tent party. We can have a lot of different
views in that party.”

But some House Democrats have criticized Fetterman, including over his
appearance at the convention.

“I know and I like John Fetterman, but he lost me last night with that
stunt,” Rep. Madeleine Dean (D-Pennsylvania) told C-SPAN’s “Washington
Journal” on Thursday. “He, like me, should be talking about how do we make
life more affordable for Americans.”

Rep. Chris Deluzio (D-Pennsylvania) said Sunday on NewsNation that he
might challenge Fetterman if he seeks reelection in 2028.

“A year ago I labeled John Fetterman ‘Trump’s favorite Democrat,’” Rep.
Brendan Boyle (D-Pennsylvania) wrote Wednesday on X. “Tonight, he yet
again proves why.”

Fetterman has not backed down. His campaign circulated the video in a
fundraising email Thursday with the subject line “Unity=Sanity.”

Fetterman has said repeatedly that he has no plan to switch parties
despite his criticisms of Democrats for reflexively opposing Trump. “I’d
be a terrible Republican who still votes overwhelmingly with Democrats,”
Fetterman wrote in May in a Washington Post op-ed.

Still, he has found himself increasingly out of step with other Democrats
on his staunch support for Israel. He is the only Democratic senator who
has voted consistently against forcing Trump to end the war with Iran.

In July, Fetterman said the only way he would abandon his party is if it
became “the anti-Israel party.”

“That’s when I would leave,” Fetterman said at an event organized by the
Hill and NewsNation.

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014gFZ_OcH5Jm_nA6TCQLV9vNZQ3IxwQpgaI2h1BUt6opMKgqxQ4_j6CfjBJo4oKDJ3HkmjzJuXDBiUKBE934hxtd7gZ251B2XCzWjQATGbA18jvJlRzq8vnwY6N4p5fw42qfeWQpuXn8ir6dXMZuzJzxiW3UqmaYMyP2h4NCH6-IUArT-xUDphBlok4twIkhDuazFd6ThyIpZeLOMFx6-eygJUY79M4DFHhFiyRB-8RI=&c=P-Hno2114z_xxlmoLCtAzqTce7ArNp-LJZlwr2ffRHR3iSNdIHcQkA==&ch=fWGMBDpuzRNgYzNPqvhwxTi1ksfkH0SNwkfF8y30h9KVZPjIRwVDoA==)

Peter,
A DOJ election monitor, an ICE agent, and an FBI agent walk into a polling location together.
The voters ask, "Which one of you is here to help us vote?"
Nobody answers.
At a Senate Judiciary hearing this week, Kash Patel announced the FBI may send agents to the polls this November:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014gFZ_OcH5Jm_nA6TCQLV9vNZQ3IxwQpgaI2h1BUt6opMKgqxQ4_j6CfjBJo4oKDJ3HkmjzJuXDBiUKBE934hxtd7gZ251B2XCzWjQATGbA18jvJlRzq8vnwY6N4p5fw42qfeWQpuXn8ir6dXMZuzJzxiW3UqmaYMyP2h4NCH6-IUArT-xUDphBlok4twIkhDuazFd6ThyIpZeLOMFx6-e0iXvK7jivQ9b31EhQsBWBM=&c=P-Hno2114z_xxlmoLCtAzqTce7ArNp-LJZlwr2ffRHR3iSNdIHcQkA==&ch=fWGMBDpuzRNgYzNPqvhwxTi1ksfkH0SNwkfF8y30h9KVZPjIRwVDoA==)
---
The Trump admin has now threatened or committed to send DOJ election monitors, ICE agents, and FBI agents to the polls this November.
This is getting out of control. If Trump has his way, every federal employee not laid off in the DOGE cuts will be standing outside a polling location on November 3rd. What's next, FDA inspectors? Lord knows they aren't inspecting the food anymore.
We can't be intimidated by these threats. We have to get out and vote, put an end to this lunacy, and save our Democracy. We must make this election too big to rig.
And that's where Defend Our Courts comes in. We're fighting to expand the firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts that can prevent Trump's election rigging, on a national scale, while turning out voters in states with key House and Senate races.
There are only 45 days until the election. We need the support of Democrats everywhere in this final stretch to make a major impact. I don't want to write this post.
I'm going to anyway.
A Democratic candidate for governor of Texas just released a campaign ad featuring a woman who attended the January 6th rally. The rally that sent a mob to the Capitol. The rally that sent people into that building to beat police officers with flagpoles and fire extinguishers. The rally where I held the line.
Her name is Gina Hinojosa. The woman in the ad is Lynn Davenport. Davenport describes herself as a "staunch conservative" who attended the January 6th rally but didn't go into the Capitol. Hinojosa's campaign is featuring her as a crossover voter -- proof that even conservatives are done with Greg Abbott.
I understand the political logic. I do. Texas is hard. Abbott is entrenched. You show crossover appeal wherever you can find it.
But this isn't just any crossover voter. This is someone who was at that rally. The rally where people were whipped into a frenzy and sent to destroy our democracy. The rally where my brothers and sisters in uniform were brutalized. The rally where over 140 officers were assaulted -- some of whom never came back to work. Some of whom took their own lives afterward.
Michael Fanone said it better than I can. Mike was beaten and electroshocked on his neck with a Taser that day. He had a heart attack. He lost consciousness. He said: "They would rather campaign alongside an insurrectionist than campaign alongside an officer that fought to defend the Capitol on January 6th. That is disgusting."
He's right.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..v1F4Jp54TuUnFOS-siRHjhk0wBiB_tpa8Xkg_TW3lDY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=217334959)
I've spent the last five years fighting the whitewashing of January 6th. I've fought the pardons. I've fought the denialism. I've fought the people who want to rewrite what happened that day into something it wasn't. And now I have to fight a Democrat who thinks featuring someone from that rally is a good campaign strategy.
There's a version of this argument that says: she didn't storm the Capitol, she just attended the rally, it's not fair to lump everyone together. I've heard it. I don't buy it.
The rally was the mechanism. It was the match. You don't get to say "I was just at the match" and walk away clean. Not from this.
I'm not telling Texans not to vote for Hinojosa. Greg Abbott is a disaster and I want him out. But Democrats cannot keep making the calculation that accountability for January 6th is something we can trade away for political convenience. Every time we do that, we tell the officers who bled that day that their sacrifice was worth less than a polling advantage.
It wasn't. It isn't.
I held that line. Mike Fanone held that line. Hundreds of officers held that line.
The least the Democratic Party can do is not feature the people who were on the other side of it in their campaign ads.
That's not too much to ask.
-Harry

| Peter, I'll be honest with you. I've been watching the debate over the SAVE America Act in Washington — and while I'm cheering for it to pass, I've been in this fight long enough to know something most people won't say: **We cannot afford to wait on Washington to save our elections.** While politicians debate, the Democrat ground game does not stop. Their voter registration staffers are at their tables right now. Their ballot chasers are making their calls. Their door knockers are hitting their lists. _And if we are not doing the same thing — right now — we are falling behind._ **I know this because I've lived it.** In 2024, my team spent over a year embedded on the ground in Pennsylvania before Election Day. We helped register hundreds of thousands of new Republican voters. We chased down every outstanding mail-in ballot we legally could. We drove voters to the polls on Election Day. **That is why Pennsylvania went red.** Not because of any law. Not because of any court ruling. Because of boots on the ground, day after day, doing the unglamorous, exhausting, absolutely essential work of grassroots organizing.

Friends,
**Today the California Supreme Court made their ruling on our legal ballot investigation into voter fraud. Here’s what you should know.**
