Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I’m not trying to be dramatic. This is just the honest truth.
_Greg Abbott is spending $12 million on negative ads attacking me_ — right now, on TV and radio across Texas.
Here’s why: The most recent independent polling has us ahead. Siena has us up 49–45. Marist has us up 49–46. Univision has us tied at 47–47.
Abbott knows he’s losing ground. He’s scared, and he’s trying to buy his way back into the lead.
This is the painful part: If we don’t raise $2,000,000 this week, _we will not be able to respond_. There’s no time to wait.
My team isn’t just trying to hit a fundraising number to feel good about it. This is the actual amount of money we need _this week_ to put our message in front of Texas voters and counter Abbott’s misleading attacks.
The truth is that Abbott has the financial resources to blunt our momentum and bury our lead. Every day his attacks go unanswered is a day we’re losing ground.
We have just six days — from now until September 30 — to raise the funds we need to fight back.
**[Will you pitch in $5 right now to help us raise the $2,000,000 we urgently need to protect our lead and take Texas back?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260925_1_2million.WqLq7W&refcode=em20260925-2223&amount=5&t=1&akid=2223%2E299639%2EvrLqmX)**

**When I served in a Combat Search and Rescue squadron in Afghanistan, we operated under one sacred rule: Leave no man behind.**
**If an American was pinned down, you didn't debate if it was convenient. You spun the rotors, flew into danger, and did whatever it took to protect the team.
[Right now, the team we need to protect is our razor-thin Republican Majority in the House.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyNV9NWi1MQi4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMzQ5MTMtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MjVfTVotTEIuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDM0OTEzLTI4OTkifQ/IBVrdbAGgDbbpPzhHjFA5A)

This isn't a request to fund a political campaign. This is a call to resource a counter-offensive. I need to know exactly who is willing to get in the trenches and fight back with me.
[Don't wait for someone else to step up. Click the link below right now to deploy a contribution of $25, $50, or $100 directly into the fight to protect our team and save the House Majority.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyNV9NWi1MQi4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMzQ5MTMtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MjVfTVotTEIuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDM0OTEzLTI4OTkifQ/ANDd2mAHI4AcBtMGWEiKHA)

**My mother often tells me about a little boy who, twenty years ago, smiled at her as he walked past. Though I was not there, I see the little boy, now surely a man, and hope he still carries that same warmth that blessed my mother.**
"Let us, then, fellow-citizens, unite with one heart and one mind. Let us restore to social intercourse that harmony and affection, without which liberty and even life itself are but dreary things."
-- Thomas Jefferson, March 4, 1801
**Pause.
Breathe.

| Dear friends and neighbors,
Thank you for your support, encouragement, and belief in this campaign. Every conversation, message, and share helps us reach more people and bring our vision for [Virginia's 8th Congressional District](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001muaLS40lj0bpWU6NeSmuChSve3xjj8_0o4EM8fTd1SBjAhEw4Xm8dyJtJ0hxqCQOHcERSqYwUohbbdNzpxcRPW-cQcbsGSoGGWfo5lwamGDHNiqgLZENVgkyUo0O6wTamqqG6NFw5uC1jZEL_vPfDqPMp6bccjLrdOznBqfwdIOKm4pJ3_Z2dmT5Hy3j7hBwNdH1YBEmMVw=&c=lFeXVKBCZ4QUzS7GA0aTaUq8x9eJT3zFY_YQkaCYYEtHrNohdAiy3Q==&ch=A8gid41NmGvzm0o257gB8ZewsoElRrVniH-iJ2ThqMrEKinr0klzqA==) to life.
Recently, I had the opportunity to share that vision at the Arlington County Civic Federation annual campaign forum on September 8. The Patch also recently featured a [candidate profile](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001muaLS40lj0bpWU6NeSmuChSve3xjj8_0o4EM8fTd1SBjAhEw4Xm8d_4EdPm6GJ6JqeXJDYDi4sh63PFn97pA_fQHIDr2QJE59lkrAINwO-wbdYCsZj69AVPxjfmfPj3RSkEeJN-LU5zYiOftcB6bV8DC2omqmfmkStZ84JP_z_TiW4jwdhnniGMS3Qx5HYwMW-IjcPehdNGKtWCEow-wcZE1YVVXJLMzMkC4FvOkeAvmwkxg7jD-fJcY0_BCHK4h1GNR9oOlbqI=&c=lFeXVKBCZ4QUzS7GA0aTaUq8x9eJT3zFY_YQkaCYYEtHrNohdAiy3Q==&ch=A8gid41NmGvzm0o257gB8ZewsoElRrVniH-iJ2ThqMrEKinr0klzqA==), helping more voters learn about our campaign and the issues that matter to our community.
Please help us keep the momentum going by sharing my information with your friends and neighbors. Visit my website at [shellyarnoldi4va.org](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001muaLS40lj0bpWU6NeSmuChSve3xjj8_0o4EM8fTd1SBjAhEw4Xm8dxt4B9Fcgblho6Civp2U113BJlztA4CBa6sjE0cK2N7lYgbXhQNL91zgyVdcK42oABU5uIRa_h0LJjwUgrWLhF-8ASmNAQEjTitVWXFXP9g7PKXTK7SRRKc=&c=lFeXVKBCZ4QUzS7GA0aTaUq8x9eJT3zFY_YQkaCYYEtHrNohdAiy3Q==&ch=A8gid41NmGvzm0o257gB8ZewsoElRrVniH-iJ2ThqMrEKinr0klzqA==) to learn about upcoming events and find opportunities to meet in person.
If you would like to help at the polls or host an event, please reply to this email or contact me directly. I would love to hear from you.
And, most importantly, please make a plan to get out and vote. Together, we can build a movement that is too big to fail.
With gratitude, Shelly Arnoldi

Fifty years ago, Congress first passed the Hyde Amendment, banning abortion coverage for anyone enrolled in Medicaid. Today, it still denies coverage to millions and has even expanded to include military families, federal employees, and Indigenous people who receive care through the Indian Health Service, and many others.

[The Equal Access to Abortion Coverage in Health Insurance (EACH) Act would end the dangerous Hyde Amendment.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139935820/649004147/700595525?sourceid=1151607&utm_campaign=27emeus-0901aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=eachact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjM5MjM3Yy1lYmI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYH1i1l17sUhaJHy14DmwDcojD_Z9PY9p101bt7Z4pA=&emci=2412838d-83b7-f111-a6a9-0022482a933b&emdi=0b39237c-ebb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237)

In 1977, Rosie Jiménez became the first known person to die after she couldn't afford an abortion once Medicaid stopped covering it. [Her death was preventable.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139935821/649004148/700595525?sourceid=1151607&utm_campaign=27emeus-0901aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=eachact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjM5MjM3Yy1lYmI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYH1i1l17sUhaJHy14DmwDcojD_Z9PY9p101bt7Z4pA=&emci=2412838d-83b7-f111-a6a9-0022482a933b&emdi=0b39237c-ebb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237) 50 years later, people are still forced to delay care, sacrifice rent and food, or continue pregnancies against their will because their insurance won't cover abortion.

[The EACH Act would stop this discrimination. It guarantees abortion coverage for everyone enrolled in federal health programs, no matter their income or where they live.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139935822/649004149/700595525?sourceid=1151607&utm_campaign=27emeus-0901aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=eachact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjM5MjM3Yy1lYmI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYH1i1l17sUhaJHy14DmwDcojD_Z9PY9p101bt7Z4pA=&emci=2412838d-83b7-f111-a6a9-0022482a933b&emdi=0b39237c-ebb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237)

This month carries the weight of history. September 28 marks International Safe Abortion Day and 26 years since the FDA approved mifepristone. September 30 marks 50 years of the Hyde Amendment blocking abortion coverage for people who can least afford to pay out of pocket.

Fifty years is fifty years too long. [The EACH Act would finally end Hyde's harm, but only if Congress hears from people like you! Tell your lawmakers to push for passage of the bill today.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/139935823/649004150/700595525?sourceid=1151607&utm_campaign=27emeus-0901aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=eachact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjM5MjM3Yy1lYmI4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYH1i1l17sUhaJHy14DmwDcojD_Z9PY9p101bt7Z4pA=&emci=2412838d-83b7-f111-a6a9-0022482a933b&emdi=0b39237c-ebb8-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237)

#
---
[ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTB9AAwAAAAAAylx5faMExlqIkMI3yU8huCWRUJrsSqDIyzPtzgr9xOO5RR_rWMA-yeIXPKm7SNy8a6WrE4TlNmOGjSHG-Aj6hqLRsCi_AF4phfgAKT1)

Fellow Patriot,[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTB9AAwAAAAAAylx5faNe7rLaxLgYTBvZkLxwD_0ZsPp5ty-rFpP8kDLbzEkOLWcKVCOeFAaRa3LH1uKxVgsYm9c-ysy35dnYkgWQtiN3ftJJNtXWWsv) **_You worked for what you have._** **_You paid your taxes._** **_You saved for retirement._** And after a lifetime of doing the right thing, every trip to the grocery store, every utility bill, and every medical expense reminds you just how much harder it is to make your money stretch under the left’s radical policies. So I have to ask: **_How much MORE should American taxpayers be expected to shoulder?_** **President Trump's new "public charge" rule would give federal immigration officers greater discretion to deny green cards and admission to immigrants who are either** _**on welfare**_**or deemed** _**likely to become dependent on taxpayer-funded public assistance**_**.** To AMAC Action, that is common sense: If someone wants to build a permanent future in America and become a citizen, taxpayers shouldn't be expected to finance it for them. _They should be able to show reasonable promise that they can contribute to the economy rather than become a burden on the taxpayer._ And it is long overdue, especially in light of shocking revelations about widespread **fraud rings** in places like **Minneapolis** , where individuals of mostly Somali origin **_have defrauded the public to the tune of billions of dollars._** Yet, this hasn’t stopped Democrats from a full-force meltdown. **A coalition of 22 Democrat states, all led by New York City’s Zohran Mamdani, have filed a lawsuit to block President Trump.** But my friend, here’s what gets me: **YOU are the one who spent decades paying into the system.** You contributed to Social Security and Medicare. You paid for schools, roads, national defense, and assistance for Americans who fell on hard times. **You worked. You saved. You played by the rules.** **And now you're being asked to stretch your retirement dollars further and further while Washington fights over how much more taxpayers should provide.** But why should, you, an American taxpayer, be expected to shoulder migrants draining our public resources? Instead of supporting our families and saving our hard-earned money, Democrats are emphatic about suing Trump to stop him. Once again, proving their loyalty to foreigners rather than American Citizens. _**We should be outraged that individuals on welfare can be granted citizenship in the first place.**_ **The United States should not and cannot be the food pantry of the world.** Productive, taxpaying citizens are already asked to shoulder an enormous load to maintain critical infrastructure, fund welfare and entitlements for American citizens, and pay for the nation’s defense – as well as the defense of many other nations around the world.But you know all this - **and you also know that President Trump’s efforts will go nowhere unless he can prove he has overwhelming support.** The Left won’t be able to lie that the American people want this.**[And today AMAC ACTION is putting all that firepower behind President Trump’s efforts to protect our decades of hard work by asking you to help.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTB9AAwAAAAAAylx5faO2nvtXF8UMJMwQ0W5h0co_GxxsQpm3zvTiqEvqtIJIcqsNBTYjJ4yFyLNCrxjPKjXLIsa_hutHR7dxDvQoy6uKQyRdKh1AXyC)** My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I'm the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. subject: Heroes in American Conservation: Meet the woman who saved the Everglades, Marjory Stoneman Douglas
body:
Meet American Conservation Hero Marjory Stoneman Douglas
Meet American Conservation Hero Marjory Stoneman Douglas
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066473/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066476/38SyG9Xl)
---
#
Meet American Conservation Hero Marjory Stoneman Douglas
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Who is she?_**
Marjory Stoneman Douglas (1890–1998) is most famously known through her copious writings. She wrote a famous column for The Miami Herald about everything that interested her – from women’s rights to urban planning - and freelanced mostly fiction stories, many of which were inspired by the Everglades and had environmental themes.
#
**_“There are no other Everglades in the world.” – Majory Stoneman Douglas_**
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Why is she the “Guardian of the Glades”?_**
Douglas wasn’t just inspired by the beauty and wildlife of the Everglades. She saw the importance of protecting it. Her most famous book, _River of Grass_ , was key in changing the public’s perception of the Everglades and was published the same year [**Everglades National Park was established in 1947.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066480/38SyG9Xl)
#
Douglas also founded the Friends of the Everglades in 1969, which helped prevent a jetport from tearing down the Everglades' Big Cypress region. She was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 1993 for her lifelong work to preserve the Everglades.
#
Defenders of Wildlife is continuing what Douglas started to protect the Everglades from new development threats. We helped advocate for the [**Everglades to Gulf Conservation Area,**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066482/38SyG9Xl) which will provide habitat critical to more than 100 protected species. Defenders is also a decades-long leader in recovering the [**endangered Florida Panther,**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066484/38SyG9Xl) which relies on habitat in the Everglades region.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How can you become a conservation hero?_**
Douglas used her talents as a writer to advocate for the proper protection of the Everglades. You can use your talents to promote the protection of unique wildlife and their habitats too! You can also support land conservation efforts, like [**Everglades to Gulf,**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6066486/38SyG9Xl) and speak out within your community to protect natural areas. Never underestimate the power of your voice or pen.
#
|
---
###
_A note on our Heroes in American Conservation series: Our country has a long and complex history, populated with high-profile figures whose views may have been complicated or divisive in their time as well as ours. We present these conservationists in the interest of creating a greater understanding of the roots of the American conservation movement, and to inspire you to make your own contribution to ongoing conversations about how we preserve our wild world._
#

---

clean_body: Too many leaders in Washington seem to have lost their brains, their hearts AND their courage. | | | = Friend, I recently visited Dorothy's House and the Land of Oz Museum here in Kansas. At one point, I watched a clip of Dorothy and Toto — along with their sidekicks — walking down the Yellow Brick Road toward Oz and the Wizard. At that moment, I realized that the Scarecrow, Tin Man and Cowardly Lion were the perfect metaphor for what’s wrong in Washington today. Kansans deserve leaders who will open their hearts to the people they’re representing, think critically about how to solve tough problems and have the courage to stand up to the corruption and chaos in Washington.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Friend, we have too many politicians in D.C. right now who — much like the Scarecrow — have lost their minds. They’ve stopped using their brains to solve problems. Instead, they’re doing whatever their president or their party tells them to do. That’s not good for Kansas or the country. We’ve got a lot of leaders who, just like the Tin Man, have lost their hearts. They’ve voted to cut healthcare and take SNAP benefits away from children — that’s what my opponent, Sen. Roger Marshall, has done. To make things even worse, far too many people in Washington are running around without courage, just like the Cowardly Lion. Kansas needs a leader who is courageous enough to fight for their people — even if that means the president bullies them, calls them names or picks on them for it. If I’m elected, I will think for myself about what Kansas needs — not Washington. I’ll open my heart to people’s pain. And I’ll have the courage to help them, even when it goes against what a president or party bosses want.= Thanks for standing with me, Adam | Adam Hamilton is a husband, father, pastor and fifth-generation Kansan. Now, he’s running for U.S. Senate as an independent-minded Democrat. Just like you, he’s tired of the chaos and corruption in Washington that is harming our farmers, raising costs at the checkout line and making critical health care services unattainable. He hears your concerns and is ready to get to work for you. Early polling shows Adam neck-and-neck in this race, and with your help, we can win big this November. = | | = | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com Rather donate by check or by mail? clean_body: 96% of the TV ads in this race are for my opponent. We have five weeks to fix it. | Fellow Patriot - I have bad news, and I need you to hear it from me. Nearly EVERY AD in South Carolina is either in favor of my far-Left opponent or attacking me. 96% of the ads in this race are Annie Andrews' ads. Only 4% are for us. What does this mean? It means Annie Andrews and her liberal Super PAC allies are pouring millions into South Carolina's airwaves. Turn on the TV in Greenville, Columbia, Charleston, or Myrtle Beach, and you're seeing her ads, one after another, with almost nothing from us to answer them. When South Carolina voters only hear one side, they start believing it. That's what Andrews is counting on. We're in the final stretch. Every TV slot we don't buy in the next five weeks goes to Andrews by default. Once those slots are gone, they're gone for good. I won't let the liberal PACs buy this seat without a fight. But I can't win this on my own. The grassroots has to show up now. That’s why I'm turning to you. The Left has the Super PACs.I have you. I’m proud to have been to all of them several times, because I believe real leaders show up. **$1.2 billion** — the total amount of funding I’ve been able to bring back to our state (so far) by suing the lawless Trump administration. And as governor, I’ll always stand up for our rights. **21.1%** — the percent decrease in synthetic opioid deaths across our state since November 2023, thanks in part to the $900 million I won in court against Big Pharma to help our communities recover. **Zero** — the amount of interest students will pay on their loans and living stipends for the job training and earn-and-learn programs I’ll kick off as governor. **[I have one last number for you: six. That’s how many weekends we have left from now until Election Day, and we’ve got to spend every one of them getting the word out. So please, can you help fuel our voter outreach by pitching in one of the 1,000 grassroots donations we’re looking to earn by the end of this week? # Iran
* **Iran pushes seven-day plan to end U.S. war in meetings with Qatari, Pakistani mediators:** Iran is pushing a seven-day roadmap to end the war with the U.S., as Iranian officials held meetings with Qatari and Pakistani mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.
* The plan, which Tehran said was transmitted via mediators, calls for an end to hostilities on all fronts, including Gaza and Lebanon, the release of at least $12 billion in frozen Iranian assets, sanctions waivers for Iranian oil, an end to the U.S. naval blockade, and immediate nuclear talks. Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz on the seventh day.
* The proposal seeks to revive key provisions of the June U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding, which later collapsed amid mutual accusations of violations.
* A White House official told CNN that discussions through mediators were "positive and constructive," while another U.S. official told the New York Times that Washington would not rush into an agreement.
* **Iran 's Pezeshkian says Tehran open to nuclear verification, agreement with U.S.: **Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian [said](https://substack.com/redirect/8f24aada-c2e2-41eb-a67b-e9a069b0b396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tehran remains willing to reach an agreement with Washington and would accept international verification of its nuclear program and lower uranium enrichment levels, in an interview with Fox News.
* Asked whether Iran wants a nuclear bomb, Pezeshkian said, "Not at all," citing the late Supreme Leader's religious prohibition on weapons of mass destruction. "We are willing to dilute [enriched uranium] ... We are willing to submit ourselves to verification," he added.
* Pezeshkian said Iran still wants to move forward based on the previous agreement reached with the Trump administration. "If the current American government, within international legal frameworks, wishes to reach an agreement, fine," he said, adding that Tehran would not tie diplomacy to the timing of U.S. elections.
* **Iran warns "flights for everyone or no one" as UAE, Iraq enforce U.S. aviation sanctions: **The UAE [suspended](https://substack.com/redirect/02852329-1ae2-4156-a04c-d201bcfe3175?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) all flights operated by Iranian airlines on Thursday, citing new U.S. sanctions threatening airports and aviation companies that continue servicing Iranian carriers. Iraq, Oman, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Turkmenistan have also imposed restrictions.
* Iran warned neighboring countries against enforcing the measures. Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei urged them not to join what he called the U.S. "adventure."
* "Flights in the region are either open to everyone or to no one," Supreme Leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber wrote in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/0f726049-5f76-4bda-a392-3056e532e622?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X. "If Iran is denied the ability to fly and receive airport services, no country in the region will have access to these facilities either."

# Yemen
* **Saudi, Turkish, and Pakistani military chiefs to hold urgent talks on support for Riyadh:** The military chiefs of Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan [will hold](https://substack.com/redirect/887b7e08-a41e-4a10-aeeb-32c9618380c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an urgent meeting to discuss support for Riyadh under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, following Ansarallah attacks on Saudi cities and energy infrastructure. The countries' three foreign ministers met in New York on Thursday.
* The countries signed the agreement on August 7, stipulating that an armed attack against one would be considered an attack against all three. They have since begun establishing mechanisms to implement the pact, including a Saudi-based secretariat and expanded military cooperation.
* Pakistan said earlier this month that no military response to the Ansarallah attacks was then under discussion, while stressing it would fulfill its obligations if required. "When time comes, [we] will act under the agreement," Foreign Ministry spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan said.
* **France to send troops, radars, and defense systems to protect Saudi oil port:** France [will deploy](https://substack.com/redirect/131a19a1-864a-44af-8a81-1194da7bcfc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) soldiers, radars, and defense systems to Saudi Arabia to protect the Red Sea oil export hub of Yanbu following an Ansarallah attack, French President Emmanuel Macron said Thursday, according to Le Monde.
* Macron said the deployment was intended to protect the site, not involve French forces in the fighting. Yanbu, which handles several million barrels of oil a day, was "severely damaged" in the attacks, he said.
* **Ansarallah claims attacks on Saudi military sites; government forces claim gains in Lahj:** Yemen's Ansarallah said it attacked several Saudi military sites, including the Al-Tuwal area in Jizan and missile positions at Al-Dagharir camp on Friday. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the attacks.
* Separately, Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claimed they captured the summit of Mount Numan and the Dar al-Kafir area in Lahj following an overnight operation. Ansarallah has not confirmed this.

# Palestine
* **Israeli airstrike kills Palestinian, wounds others in Khan Younis:** An Israeli airstrike [targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/b9f2c6fe-5142-405c-b259-7b1639cf0389?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a vehicle in the Mawasi area of Khan Younis on Friday, killing one Palestinian and wounding several others, according to WAFA.
* **Israeli settlers attack Palestinians, torch vehicles:**
* **Nablus:** Israeli settlers [assaulted and detained](https://substack.com/redirect/bc072d6a-0fdf-468c-a618-336a653cfa6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a group of Palestinian young men after stopping their vehicle in Beita's Al-Arma area, WAFA reported on Friday. Israeli forces separately raided Beita and detained a 17-year-old Palestinian boy from his home.
* **Ramallah and Al-Bireh:** Settlers [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/0aab2815-2472-49d6-8570-488e11fc418b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday to three Palestinian vehicles in Rantis and spray-painted racist slogans on several homes.
* **Across the occupied West Bank:** There are now [942 Israeli checkpoints](https://substack.com/redirect/afa49ece-dce3-4f46-a72b-aa2c2be58264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), gates, and other obstacles across the occupied West Bank, including 824 fixed closure points, increasingly restricting Palestinian movement, the Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission reported.
* Thirteen new fixed gates and checkpoints were documented over the past two months, including 10 in Jenin.
* **Israeli police kill Palestinian man, bringing 2026 toll inside Israel to 10:** Israeli police shot and killed a Palestinian man in his 30s in Yafa Al-Naseriyye, in northern Israel, Thursday night, bringing the documented number of Palestinians killed by police inside of Israel this year to 10.
* In most cases, victims' families and local groups disputed police accounts of the shootings. Previous investigations into Israeli police killings of Palestinian citizens have also been closed without charges against officers.
* **UNRWA faces $100 million cashflow deficit amid Israeli attacks, U.S. funding cutoff:** UNRWA is [facing](https://substack.com/redirect/b266ba3d-20ff-426a-a27a-94065e5cd804?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a $100 million cashflow deficit, forcing it to cut service hours by 20% and reduce salaries for local staff.
* The U.S., historically UNRWA's largest donor, has withheld funding since 2024. Israel has moved to dismantle the agency's operations in occupied East Jerusalem and restrict its work across the occupied Palestinian territory. In 2026, Israeli authorities demolished UNRWA's historic East Jerusalem headquarters, carried out an operation at its Kalandia vocational training center and forced the closure of its Old City health clinic. Nearly 400 UNRWA personnel have been killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza since October 2023.
* **Abbas warns UN that Israeli policies threaten Palestinians ' "very existence"**: Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, in prerecorded remarks after the U.S. denied visas to a Palestinian delegation for the second consecutive year, [told](https://substack.com/redirect/7b90e8b1-69d8-45ad-93a5-9035ba7f9a96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the UN General Assembly Thursday that Israeli policies now threaten Palestinians' "very life and existence," citing "killing, destruction, starvation, attempts at displacement, as well as a genocidal war that has created an unprecedented humanitarian catastrophe."
* Abbas called Israeli activity in the West Bank a "malicious colonial plan" and urged the international community to implement a two-state solution based on international law.
* He also discussed the Palestinian Authority's plans to hold legislative elections on Nov. 28--the first since 2005-2006.

# Lebanon
* **Israel launches airstrikes, shelling and incursions across southern Lebanon despite ceasefire:**
* **Nabatieh:** Israeli warplanes [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/42c72c43-6bad-4b38-90e6-edae676432e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two strikes within less than 15 minutes on the outskirts of Zawtar Al-Sharqiyah and another strike on Bani Hayyan on Friday, Lebanon's National News Agency (NNA) reported.
* An Israeli drone also struck between Kfar Tibnit and Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, while artillery shelling hit the outskirts of Zawtar Al-Sharqiyah, Mayfadoun, Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, and Kfar Tibnit.
* **Marjayoun:** Israeli forces [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/6affbfd1-4b77-436d-b61f-c40e996295ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to several homes in the Jallahiya area of Khiam.
* **Hasbaya:** Israeli forces [advanced into](https://substack.com/redirect/1fe5be5e-16d3-42fd-a63b-676ecea10795?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Sadana area outside Kfar Shouba, surrounded a farm where several shepherds were present and opened fire around it.
* Artillery shelling was also reported around Sadana and the outskirts of Hebbariyeh, alongside heavy machine-gun fire.
* **" Lebanon wants to open a new page with Iran": **Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam [met](https://substack.com/redirect/fe3925bc-bfa4-4b8f-9473-9af5327d45b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, saying Lebanon wants to "open a new page" with Iran, establishing state-to-state relations, respect for sovereignty and non-interference, NNA reported.
* Salam said Lebanon "paid a heavy price" in its security, stability and economy and does not want to be an arena for regional conflicts. Salam also asked Iran to nominate a new ambassador to Beirut, nearly six months after Lebanon declared Tehran's former envoy persona non grata.
* The call for state-to-state relations comes amid Iran's longstanding political and military support of the Lebanese resistance group Hezbollah. Israel has continued attacks on Lebanon despite the signing of a U.S.-sponsored Framework Agreement on June 26 providing for a gradual Israeli withdrawal from occupied Lebanese territory in exchange for the disarmament of Hezbollah.

# U.S. News
* **Netanyahu excoriates Mamdani, world leaders at UN amid Israel 's growing isolation:** Israeli Prime Minister **Benjamin Netanyahu** opened his UN General Assembly address Thursday by telling "any other moral cowards who haven't yet left this hall" to leave, as many attendees [walked out](https://substack.com/redirect/6f2c3259-6bd0-4eb8-b393-c391f283e6cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) amid broad international condemnation of Israel's conduct in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.
* Netanyahu devoted a portion of his speech to New York Mayor **Zohran Mamdani** , calling him "antisemitic" and saying "shame on you for distorting the facts... shame on you for spitting in the face of truth." Mamdani called Netanyahu a "war criminal" earlier in the week.
* Netanyahu also rejected French President **Emmanuel Macron** 's Wednesday condemnation of daily Israeli "violations" in the West Bank as a "grotesque absurdity," highlighting the recent death of a French-Israeli citizen Netanyahu claimed came at the hands of Hamas.
* Nearly two dozen protesters, including Democratic nominee for Congress **Darializa Avila Chevalier** , whistleblower **Chelsea Manning** , and actor **Hannah Einbinder** , were arrested outside the UN on Thursday.
* **Mortgage rates hit 7% for the first time since January 2025 as Iran war fallout hits housing market:** The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate [rose](https://substack.com/redirect/3e558374-d5f2-49e3-b522-7f8875e4a1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to 7.03% this week, up from 6.3% a year ago, Freddie Mac said Thursday, as war-driven energy costs and inflation push borrowing costs higher.
* Rates dipped below 6% in late February before climbing steadily after the U.S. and Israel launched attacks on Iran on Feb. 28. Existing home sales fell 2% in August to their lowest level since June 2025.
* **Trump administration airs government-funded ad against socialism:** A new 30-second Trump administration TV ad featuring President Donald Trump [denouncing](https://substack.com/redirect/5c8defab-835c-4572-9f06-6c748bbf24b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "communism, socialism, and Marxism" began airing Wednesday night on Fox News, Newsmax, and connected platforms, disclaiming it was "paid for by the U.S. government," according to ad tracker AdImpact.
* Sen. **Maggie Hassan** (D-N.H.) sent a letter to White House Chief of Staff **Susie Wiles** demanding the ad's total cost, precise funding source, and purpose, saying it "raises deep concerns about the Trump Administration's use of taxpayer dollars" and potential violations of laws barring appropriated funds from promoting a political party.
* The White House called the spots "public service announcements" without addressing funding questions.
* Musician **JMSN** , whose song "Love Me" appears in the ad, said he did not authorize its use and is "looking for a lawyer."
* **CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters regain White House access despite delays; TV pool still suspended** : CNN, MS NOW, and Politico journalists were [readmitted](https://substack.com/redirect/9713e587-3213-44ad-875d-10ab4be3a6f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the White House around noon Thursday after a chaotic morning in which they were initially blocked despite an overnight order from Judge **Timothy J. Kelly** demanding their credentials be "immediately" restored. CNN's **Betsy Klein** saying she was turned away three times before being let in.
* The major networks' TV pool remained suspended. No print reporters were allowed into President Donald Trump and Chinese President **Xi Jinping** 's meeting in the Oval Office and no network aired live footage.
* **Senate narrowly fails to block Trump from ordering further Iran strikes** : The Senate [voted](https://substack.com/redirect/779c0b8c-5877-4284-bb06-562d48b0c730?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 49-50 against a war powers resolution that would have blocked President Donald Trump from ordering further strikes on Iran, with Republicans **Rand Paul**(Ky.), **Susan Collins**(Maine), **Lisa Murkowski**(Alaska)**,** and **Thom Tillis**(N.C.) breaking from the party to vote yes alongside the Democrats; Democrat **John Fetterman (Pa.)** voted no, and Sen. **Angela Alsobrooks**(Md.) did not vote.
* **Ten Democrats back Casar 's bill to ban superintelligence, pause advanced AI development:** Ten House Democrats, Reps. **Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez** and **Ro Khanna** , are [cosponsoring](https://substack.com/redirect/c9f94ad9-3d9e-49a6-a920-31b8f1f90d47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Rep. **Greg Casar 's **Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, which would prohibit AI "superintelligence" and pause advanced AI development until a vetting regime is established, with violators facing up to 20 years in prison. Khanna stressed the need for a verifiable pause and AI safety cooperation with China.
* **Energy Secretary Wright pushes industry for voluntary diesel export cuts amid antitrust concerns** : Energy Secretary **Chris Wright** [asked](https://substack.com/redirect/35379e8d-8f73-470c-8b0e-6f00fd264822?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) oil industry executives to voluntarily reduce diesel exports and boost domestic inventories, telling reporters in Allentown, Pennsylvania, "let's push prices down." The comments follow a Politico report that the White House was weighing a 90-day mandatory export ban that drew industry pushback.
* Energy executives working with White House officials warned that coordinating voluntary export reductions among companies could violate federal antitrust laws.
* Diesel prices have hit record highs amid supply disruptions from the Iran war and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, with U.S. exports up more than 12% since the war began and domestic inventories running 12% below the five-year average.
* **Massachusetts to investigate DraftKings ' use of AI after NYT report on targeting losing gamblers**: The Massachusetts Gaming Commission [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/f2999298-f831-482e-9365-09e47720734d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday it will examine how DraftKings and other betting companies use AI, following a New York Times investigation that found DraftKings used machine learning to identify losing gamblers most likely to keep betting when sent promotional offers.
* Massachusetts prohibits using automated systems "known or reasonably expected" to make gambling more addictive. DraftKings denied using AI "to target anyone based on losses" or market based on "indicators of potential problem gaming."
* Federal lawmakers, including Sen. **Richard Blumenthal**(D-Conn), have proposed a nationwide ban on AI-driven targeted gambling promotions in response to the Times' reporting,
* **Trump administration asks Supreme Court to revive third-country deportation policy** : The Justice Department [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/38a75e5f-2393-4c7a-9337-38b0397322bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an emergency request Thursday asking the Supreme Court to pause a lower court order requiring immigration officials to give deportees notice and a chance to challenge removal before sending them to "third countries" where they have no ties. Last week, an appellate court largely upheld the ruling and DHS was forced to cancel a flight carrying 70 would-be deportees to three countries.
* Solicitor General **D. John Sauer** wrote that the policy had enabled removal of "thousands" of people, including "some of the worst of the worst criminal aliens," and warned the lower court's ruling "undermines our standing abroad" by disrupting diplomatic arrangements with receiving nations. Justice **Ketanji Brown Jackson** gave lawyers challenging the policy until Monday to respond.
* **Federal judge rules ICE 's NYC detention conditions "inhumane and unconstitutional," orders sweeping fixes**: U.S. District Judge **Lewis A. Kaplan** [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/9ce27d20-2577-4977-8ec2-9a1c4ab7c8de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a permanent injunction against ICE over conditions at the 26 Federal Plaza detention facility in New York City, writing in a 127-page opinion that officials "intentionally concealed or recklessly disregarded the truth" about compliance with his earlier orders and that ICE "objectively deprived detainees of sleep, sanitary living conditions, basic personal hygiene needs, sufficient food and water, and adequate medical care" by holding people far longer than the facility's intended 12-hour limit.
* Kaplan found detainees were also "severely restricted" from meaningfully accessing counsel, with phone calls limited to a few minutes and often overheard by ICE staff, calling the agency's disregard of prior capacity limits "persistent, egregious, and, at a minimum, reckless, if not willful."
* The injunction requires ICE to provide at least 50 square feet of floor space per person, temperatures between 68 and 74 degrees, three daily meals, hygiene supplies, bedding for overnight detainees, an on-site medical professional at all times, and confidential attorney phone access.
* **GAO finds ICE wasted millions in rushed detention expansion push:** A Government Accountability Office report [released](https://substack.com/redirect/61fc12a4-1100-4674-99c8-8825e1d1ae0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday found ICE "wasted funds on unsuccessful detention initiatives" by launching new expansion efforts without a strategic plan, including spending nearly $3 million assembling tents at Guantanamo Bay that were never used and more than $20 million on "non-recoverable costs" for warehouses it purchased last year and now intends to sell.
* The report also found ICE is reimbursing Florida at 171% above the median rate for running "Alligator Alcatraz" and another detention facility.
* **California Supreme Court orders Riverside sheriff to return 650,000 illegally seized ballots** : The California Supreme Court [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/f1df48d4-2c1a-4ee9-ba29-4298eb889efc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday unanimously that Riverside County Sheriff **Chad Bianco** unlawfully seized about 650,000 ballots from California's 2025 special election as part of a fraud investigation state officials said had no basis, ordering their return.
* Associate Justice **Goodwin H. Liu** wrote that the seizure involved "over 1,000 boxes of documents... the most precious documents of the citizenry in a democracy: their votes."
* The investigation targeted a special election in which voters approved Proposition 50, a Democratic-backed congressional redistricting plan responding to Texas's own gerrymander. Bianco launched the probe when he was a Republican candidate for governor.
* **NSA spending billions to test AI models, exceeding prior estimates for federal oversight** : The National Security Agency is [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/7a576b28-c798-45a7-8001-ee85029dd6c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) billions of dollars this year evaluating frontier AI models through its Artificial Intelligence Security Center, according to two sources familiar with classified intelligence estimates, a figure far exceeding earlier congressional projections of just $20 million, according to The Washington Sun.
* **Pentagon investigates how F-35 parts diverted to Hong Kong:** The Pentagon [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/2bb50269-2537-4d95-8bfc-797ce16804c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that it is investigating how a shipment of F-35 fighter jet parts, in transit from Australia for repair, was diverted to Hong Kong, with a defense official saying it is "actively working with U.S. authorities and industry partners to retrieve these components."
* Bloomberg News reported the parts are now in China's possession, though the Pentagon declined to confirm this.
* The missing components reportedly relate to the F-35's canopy and weapons bay door, which, while lacking advanced avionics, could still reveal information about the plane's radar-absorbent stealth coating.

# Other International News
* **Nepal PM Shah warns UN that deadly floods are "a warning to the world" on climate change**: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah [told](https://substack.com/redirect/a8d7debe-d4c0-4261-87c0-768973207e43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the UN General Assembly Thursday that August floods that killed at least 1,453 people, with 5,500 still missing, were "not just a local tragedy," asking leaders if they had "really heard that warning" in reference to the rising threat of climate change.
* Shah noted Nepal contributes less than one-tenth of 1% of global heat-trapping emissions yet "our glaciers are retreating, our mountain slopes are becoming unstable... every major disaster threatens to erase years of development."
* Nepal has requested the maximum $20 million from the UN's loss and damage fund--a fraction of the disaster's estimated $5 billion cost. The U.S. pledged an additional $31 million in flood recovery support earlier this week.

* **U.S. arranges new trilateral Ukraine-Russia talks, possibly in UAE; Trump approves Patriot production** : The U.S. is working to [arrange](https://substack.com/redirect/c5bcb802-3745-44d5-aad0-f0cab9d43310?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new trilateral peace talks between Ukraine and Russia at a technical level, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy saying Washington has proposed the United Arab Emirates as a possible location, while the Kremlin confirmed a meeting could happen soon.
* Zelenskyy also said Trump has agreed to let Ukraine produce advanced Patriot air defense missiles domestically, though any licensed production would take more than a year to come online.
* **Argentina 's poverty rate climbs to 32.3% as Milei's economic momentum stalls**: Argentina's poverty rate [rose](https://substack.com/redirect/aee5225f-6d0b-4952-a254-33f2631da97c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to 32.3% in the first half of 2026, up from 28.2% the previous half-year, according to an official report.
* Extreme poverty rose from 6.3% to 7.5%, with roughly 9.7 million people across surveyed urban areas living below the poverty line, including nearly 45% of children under 15. Formal private-sector employment has fallen for 13 consecutive months.
* As president, Javier Milei has pursued a rigid austerity program, slashing public spending and tightening the country's monetary policy.
* **At least 41 dead after boat capsizes on Lake Tanganyika in DRC** : A boat carrying roughly 100 people and cargo [capsized](https://substack.com/redirect/c83b90d5-fe81-43ba-be5c-e7d1db59fd03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near the Congolese village of Mapera on Lake Tanganyika Thursday, killing at least 41 people and prompting ongoing search operations for remaining passengers, the Associated Press reports; 49 people have been rescued so far.
* The vessel, traveling from Kigoma, Tanzania, to Kalemie, DRC, reportedly began tilting around 1 a.m. as passengers slept, a survivor told Radio Okapi. The cause remains unclear.
* On August 28, a fire and explosion aboard the MV Pacifique on the same route killed six crew members.
* **Costa Rica 's president fires foreign minister after unauthorized attendance of Trump security summit: **Costa Rica President Laura Fernandez [dismissed](https://substack.com/redirect/387415f9-ec98-4522-8f80-e636c7815204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Foreign Minister Manuel Tovar effective immediately Thursday after he attended a Tuesday meeting of the Shield of the Americas--a U.S.-led anti-cartel coalition launched by the Trump administration in March--without notifying her, preventing her from participating herself.
* The government said Tovar's negligence "caused significant strategic damage," calling the coalition, which several right-wing Latin American presidents also attended, "fundamental to its national and public security policy."
* **U.S.-sanctioned tanker Sibu 1 freed from Somali pirates in Puntland operation** : Puntland's maritime police [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/471b2f7f-4196-49a9-9bb1-5a88e29eb40f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the force had freed the U.S.-sanctioned oil tanker Sibu 1 during a counter-piracy operation, with commander Mohamed Jama telling Reuters "the ship is free and the pirates are all in the hands of our forces."
* The Eritrea-flagged tanker, seized by six armed individuals on August 20, had been sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury in December for allegedly forming part of a "shadow fleet" helping Iranian petroleum products evade U.S. sanctions.
* Sibu 1 was at least the 13th vessel attacked off Somalia or in the Gulf of Aden this year, according to International Maritime Bureau and UKMTO data.
* **UNHCR reports 20-fold surge in Sudanese refugees fleeing to Chad amid funding shortfall** : Over 55,000 Sudanese refugees have escaped into eastern Chad since January, fueled by ongoing violence and growing instability, according to the UNHCR. More than 400 people a day have crossed from Sudan into eastern Chad over the past week--a 20-fold increase from recent months--as fighting between Sudan's army and the Rapid Support Forces intensifies across Darfur, Kordofan and Blue Nile, the UN refugee agency said.
UN Regional Refugee Coordinator Mamadou Dian Balde said arrivals describe fleeing "aerial bombardments" and "drone attacks."
* Balde also discussed the UNHCR's funding shortfall, with the agency receiving only 18% of the $1.6 billion it needs this year. He noted that the change means "less food ... less capacity for people to be relocated to safer areas ... less capacity to shelter themselves."
* The UNHCR also warned that unmet needs in Chad could push more Sudanese refugees toward attempting dangerous onward journeys to Europe, as the more than three-year civil war has displaced up to 14 million people overall, with nearly 1 million refugees having crossed into Chad since the conflict began.
* **TPLF fighters in Ethiopia take over airport as "full-blown war" resumes in Amhara:** Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) fighters have captured the Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle, the capital of Ethiopia's Tigray region, amidst fresh fighting with federal troops. Ethiopia's National Defense Force also said on Friday it [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/342b8a40-f12d-4356-a556-e73202b1a0cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 272 Tigray People's Liberation Front fighters and wounded 260 more in a counter-offensive after TPLF and allied forces attacked several areas of North Wollo in Amhara region.
* A civil aviation official at the airport, Tulu Ayenew, said on Friday that since Wednesday TPLF and government forces were fighting near the airport but eventually TPLF overpowered their opponents and are currently in full control.
* TPLF Vice President Amanuel Assefa told AFP, "We are in the situation of full-blown war now," confirming Tigrayan forces are fighting alongside local groups in Afar and Amhara. The escalation has disrupted air travel after Tigrayan forces seized three local airports, forcing the suspension of flights to the UNESCO-listed site of Lalibela.
* Last week, the TPLF formed a seven-party alliance, the Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival, aimed at ousting Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed.

Photo by Alexi J. Rosenfeld/Getty Images. Friday, September 25, 2026 -** Iran pushes seven-day plan to end U.S. war in meetings with Qatari, Pakistani mediators. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says Tehran open to nuclear verification, agreement with U.S. Iran warns "flights for everyone or no one" as UAE, Iraq enforce U.S. aviation sanctions. Saudi, Turkish, and Pakistani military chiefs to hold urgent talks on support for Riyadh. France to send troops, radars, and defense systems to protect Saudi oil port. Ansarallah claims attacks on Saudi military sites; government forces claim gains in Lahj. Israeli airstrike kills Palestinian, wounds others in Khan Younis. Israeli settlers attack Palestinians, torch vehicles. UNRWA faces $100 million cash flow deficit amid Israeli attacks, U.S. funding cutoff. Israel launches airstrikes, shelling and incursions across southern Lebanon despite ceasefire. Lebanese Prime Minister: "Lebanon wants to open a new page with Iran." Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu excoriates New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, world leaders at UN amid Israel's growing isolation. Mortgage rates hit 7% for the first time since January 2025 as Iran war fallout hits housing market. Trump administration airs government-funded ad against socialism.
