* **Preferential carve-out takes shape:** Greer told Squawk Box the subset includes U.S. agricultural products and medical devices plus[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/203a9cf9-fe73-4fee-ad1a-19f9ee147cca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Chinese consumer goods,](https://substack.com/redirect/203a9cf9-fe73-4fee-ad1a-19f9ee147cca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/203a9cf9-fe73-4fee-ad1a-19f9ee147cca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)meant to stay insulated if either side later adds tariffs.
* **Export controls stay parked:** Board of Trade talks cover[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0263e41c-dd59-4b4c-a46b-bb6bf9e84860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**["pure trade issues,"](https://substack.com/redirect/0263e41c-dd59-4b4c-a46b-bb6bf9e84860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Greer said, with national-security export controls "off the table." He did not name products, tariff changes, or start dates.
* **U.S. orders surprise jump:** China Beige Book's U.S. orders gauge at 1,295 firms rose to 13 in September from −12 a year earlier and 3 in August. The trade truce was extended two months to January.
* **Taiwan wording, weapons wait:** Xinhua said Xi urged the U.S. to "adhere to the correct position of opposing Taiwan independence." **[A $14 billion weapons package](https://substack.com/redirect/bddd1ddf-fc56-437b-89a4-874e7954bc24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** remains delayed; Taiwan's foreign ministry denounced the remarks.

* * *
* * *
# The 10-year just hit 5.183%, highest since 2007
The 10-year Treasury yield **[ticked up to 5.183%](https://substack.com/redirect/a9884691-0ac5-4a9c-bb66-a283b0edd2a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Friday after Thursday's **[highest print](https://substack.com/redirect/d3b84db0-8f84-4549-abe4-cc7477420685?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since June 2007, as hawkish Fed talk and a global bond selloff kept **[pressure on U.S. debt.](https://substack.com/redirect/d5e0f1dd-0da5-49db-b5fe-2abf9e04caa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb80fb21-3f75-4ca2-912b-3cb778da1fba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Long bond revisits 2004:** The 30-year yield rose more than 1 basis point Friday to 5.476% after levels not seen since 2004. The 2-year was up less than 1 basis point at 4.901%.
* **Rapid rises precede breaks:** John Roque of 22V Research said 16 rapid 10-year advances since 1970 each preceded a disruption, from the 1987 crash to Silicon Valley Bank in 2023.
* **October hike odds at 66%:** Traders priced a 66% chance of an October increase after Fed Governor Michael Barr said Wednesday that "further policy adjustments" can be expected.
* **Asia spreads near extremes:** Malaysia's 10-year discount to Treasuries widened to 125 basis points,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/7815cdfa-6951-49f9-823d-c739ec7c3989?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[the most since 2007,](https://substack.com/redirect/7815cdfa-6951-49f9-823d-c739ec7c3989?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while Thailand's gap reached 290 basis points and Indonesia's spread narrowed to 188.

* * *
# The bond selloff just pushed 30-year mortgages to 7.45%
The average 30-year fixed mortgage[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8e9f0fe1-11fc-44a1-b90d-6e1b920f69e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[jumped to 7.45%](https://substack.com/redirect/8e9f0fe1-11fc-44a1-b90d-6e1b920f69e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday as Treasury yields surged, while Freddie Mac's weekly survey rose to 7.03%, **[the first reading above 7% since January 2025.](https://substack.com/redirect/651ccb16-cbe0-4bd1-a0d3-a7c3f9d4b716?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b85976ac-bcab-4bbb-af8b-47050e1f057f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Daily print jumps 19 bp:** Mortgage News Daily's Thursday survey hit 7.45%, up 19 basis points from 7.26%, after an afternoon re-run as the 10-year kept climbing.
* **Freddie weekly crosses 7%:** Freddie Mac said the 30-year averaged 7.03% from 6.95%, and the 15-year climbed to 6.42% from 6.26%. A year ago the 30-year averaged 6.3%.
* **Seven percent broke Sept. 10:** Mortgage News Daily's Matthew Graham said daily 7% first broke Sept. 10 after inflation reports. The 30-year had sunk as low as 5.99% at the end of February.
* **Ten-year keeps climbing:** Realtor.com's Anthony Smith said the 10-year surged 15 basis points Wednesday to 5.11%, a 19-year high, and hovered around 5.1% Thursday afternoon.

* * *
# Trump flagged the weak yen. It just jumped
The yen rose about 1% against the dollar, its best day in two weeks, after Japan's finance minister said[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/15c071d3-86ae-4b95-a6ce-a3a6a9f71485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[President Trump raised the currency's weakness](https://substack.com/redirect/15c071d3-86ae-4b95-a6ce-a3a6a9f71485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1c0924e-70e0-4330-b2b5-de53168dd543?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Leaders called yen problematic:** Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Trump "expressed his concern" in New York on Tuesday; Takaichi told him an undervalued yen was "problematic."
* **Bessent stays closely looped:** Katayama said she and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will keep communicating closely on foreign exchange after the Trump-Takaichi meeting.
* **Record summer yen-buying:** Japan and the U.S. staged their first coordinated yen-buying since 1998 after the currency weakened beyond 160; Tokyo spent a record ¥15.4 trillion ($97.4 billion) through Aug. 26.
* **Hike has not stuck:** The Bank of Japan last week raised rates to a 31-year high, and Governor Kazuo Ueda hinted at more tightening this year.

* * *
# Warsh's 127-day overhaul still points to more hikes
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, **[127 days in,](https://substack.com/redirect/531e0bed-b2e2-4465-9eee-1c3831b9c94b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** has **[dropped traditional forward guidance](https://substack.com/redirect/5d60bb1a-2bc7-4c8e-9612-b37480b769e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and is leaning on broad financial conditions, a framework that still leaves additional rate increases on the table.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25d69dbe-abaf-461d-a918-fb256ab9d1d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Neutral scale gets dismissed:** Warsh called the old accommodative-neutral-restrictive framework "useful academically" but said it had no bearing on last week's unanimous quarter-point hike, the first since 2023.
* **Markets still price tightening:** The 2-year yield sat nearly a full percentage point above the funds rate Wednesday, the widest since 2023. This report put[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5760bd5f-4601-497f-a818-5869662d8385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[October hike odds at 70%,](https://substack.com/redirect/5760bd5f-4601-497f-a818-5869662d8385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with as many as two more through March.
* **Inflation still far off:** July PCE inflation ran at 3.7% and has sat above the 2% target for more than 51⁄2 years. Warsh has not yet cut the balance sheet; five task forces report early next year.
* **Bank thresholds may rise:** Barron's, citing Reuters, said the Fed is preparing a proposal by year's end to raise the asset levels that trigger stricter oversight of large U.S. banks.

* * *
# No power, still paying: Oracle's Jupiter problem
Oracle sent a force majeure notice on its[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/10f72d50-eabc-470a-a14a-6f8b9c3ac683?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[2.25 GW New Mexico Project Jupiter campus](https://substack.com/redirect/10f72d50-eabc-470a-a14a-6f8b9c3ac683?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , removed a key partner, and[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/53b53971-92a0-4698-bfdc-6ef6bae0214e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[still faces payment risk](https://substack.com/redirect/53b53971-92a0-4698-bfdc-6ef6bae0214e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after power and permitting delays.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41669769-6655-41f5-a7d0-a54ba31133f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **OpenAI campus, little wiggle:** The Wall Street Journal said Oracle last year made aggressive financial commitments to lease the Doña Ana County campus as part of a blitz of OpenAI compute deals, leaving little room to maneuver.
* **Partner pulled amid protests:** Oracle removed a key partner and faces local resistance. Protesters opposed to the project gathered in Santa Fe in August.
* **Guarantees tested years early:** Residual-value guarantees common to data-center structures are being tested in reverse about 5 years earlier than expected after the permitting delay, ZeroHedge reported.
* **Payment risk stays put:** The force majeure advised the top developer it would be relieved of obligations because the site cannot power up, but the payment risk still sits with Oracle, not investors.

# AI shopping agents can use your card. Banks flinch
A bank group including Bank of America and Capital One warned that AI shopping agents can[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8e2ae8a7-62c6-497a-8980-48cf920bbe0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[outrun consumer protections,](https://substack.com/redirect/8e2ae8a7-62c6-497a-8980-48cf920bbe0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while a security founder said **[machine-speed swarms already beat human monitoring.](https://substack.com/redirect/fe99cfa2-9c60-4082-bcaa-7e2300aae574?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/687dc252-d467-4136-bd97-01d5319ae2b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Agents may enter cards:** The report, also backed by NatWest, ASB Bank, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said agents may request card details or steer shoppers toward payment methods with weaker protections.
* **John Lewis traffic jumps:** British retailer John Lewis said searches from AI agents rose from 0.3% last year to 2.5% this year. Banks want disclosure when an agent is in a transaction.
* **Swarms outrun human monitors:** Polygraf AI founder Yagub Rahimov called a swarm a "digital workforce" of agents that coordinate. "You cannot secure machine-speed activity with human-speed monitoring," he said.

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: My opponent is hiding. I'll let my record speak for itself.
body:
|
#
My opponent is scared, friend. Tom Smith has refused to debate me. Voters deserve the chance to hear from both of us – to ask questions, compare records, and make an informed decision about who should represent them in Congress. He won't give them that. Maybe it’s because he doesn’t want to face his record of pushing far-right conspiracy theories, amplifying social media posts calling for the executions of “political traitors,” and being a proud attendee of January 6th. But who really knows? 🧐 **Smith is hiding. So I'll let my record speak for itself.** I've worked across the aisle to bring down costs, fought to protect Medicaid and SNAP, and taken on corruption in Washington. I'm proud of what we've accomplished – and I know there's more to do. But right now, national Republicans are flooding this district with millions in attack ads to hand this seat to a guy who won't even show up to debate. My own father was imprisoned and tortured by dictators in Cuba. I know exactly where this road leads, and I will not watch it happen here. Look at who the left is elevating. Zohran Mamdani says he wants to seize the means of production. James Talarico, running for the Senate right here in Texas, has talked about dismantling capitalism. And hear me clearly: Sharia law has no place in America, because it is fundamentally inconsistent with our Constitution. The same hate that killed Charlie Kirk, that knocked down the Twin Towers, that drove two assassination attempts on President Trump, is the hate now rising inside the Democrat Party. subject: Her colleagues can’t believe it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When we monitor our fundraising numbers each day, this is one of the first numbers we see:
**The average donation to Alexandria's campaign is just $17. Some of her colleagues can’t believe it when she tells them her average donation.**
Alexandria doesn’t spend any time calling wealthy donors asking them for big checks. She never has, and never will. Every dollar this campaign has comes from people like you chipping in what they can.
That means she is 100% focused on winning power for working people so we can pass policies like Medicare for All and universal childcare.
**And this fall, that work is taking her on the road. Let us explain:**
The House and the Senate will be decided in states where the margins are incredibly close. You know the stakes. That’s why Alexandria wants to show up in those places to rally alongside candidates like Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Angie Nixon in Florida to help organize the voters who can decide this election.
If Democrats take back the House and Senate in November from Republican control, we’ll have tangible power to put a check on Donald Trump’s agenda for the next two years and advance policies that will benefit _all of us._
**But traveling, holding events, and reaching voters at their doors takes real resources.** Because this campaign is funded entirely one $17 donation at a time, we rely on supporters like you to make it possible.
[Will you make your first donation today to help Alexandria hit the road this fall? If thousands of folks each pitched in $17 for the first time today, it would all add up to make a real difference.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260925.Eq_vov&refcode=em20260925-12350-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amount=17&t=7&akid=12350%2E2526796%2Efbu2U3)

We’re so thankful you’re a part of this movement and completely understand if it isn’t the right time to make your first donation to this campaign.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.

And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. And I’m sick of it.

My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.

**[This weekend, I officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139964383/649080660/2030301141?refcode=260925_troy_logger&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2Q3YWZiMDYtMGNiOS1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mM4mQxhKhWJaZvbP7JUSfNlJc4GRctQ1TgJ-dOxwW-0=)**

---
Let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.

When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.

After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that nothing would change unless there were working-class voices in power.

So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.

I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.

I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.

#
Hi there,
Today we have an exciting announcement: we’re rolling out Swing Left’s brand-new [**Take Action Tool**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1218?utm_source=em20260925-2900&t=1&akid=2900%2E1562180%2EOe91JN) that makes it easier than ever for anyone to find their highest-impact actions between now and Election Day!
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1218?utm_source=em20260925-2900&t=2&akid=2900%2E1562180%2EOe91JN)
**Connecting directly with voters is the single most effective way to help Democrats win the most competitive races in swing districts and states across the country.**

subject: A rescue team is preparing to move in
body:
And somewhere in South America, young women trapped inside a trafficking network may soon have a chance to walk free.

Young women may soon have a chance to escape a trafficking network. Your gift can help rescuers be ready.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
**A rescue is about to happen.** And somewhere in South America, young women trapped inside a trafficking network may soon have a chance to walk free. They came from several Latin American countries. They were promised **real jobs.** A chance to earn money. **A chance for a better life.** But police say that once these young women were brought under the control of a well-known criminal gang, the promises disappeared. Instead, they were forced into commercial sexual exploitation. **And threatened with violence or death.** Then police went undercover at a brothel tied to the organization. What they found made this even more urgent. Several of the young women they encountered **may be minors**. Now, authorities are preparing to act. **And I am asking you to help us be ready.**
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTGP2zAMhX-NvMWQJUWuBw0FjHRKG3TpKDAS5RC1LJ8k53D__uAk4003knx8jx_472zPQDMt02-IaKa0rjYXCxmL27AiRCprxhUyLVNN0Qou9IEPB3G04Crd0SpovFGglda6QdP1A5eaK8Gbmwkavbr2grtrQOk0YucUonKBd0L2vCGzG_JBHLsfgndDOxx96IerdApFx1ExxdFTTbndb8tYyONSCebWpdjM5lbrWpj8ycSJiVNBt2VsS9oWn0LIiD7FsFdQKS1tytOuSsE-ATOC_xAPKCZPJW3ZoXXJI5Pjrz-Xy99OiV4rJvRWo43oaYtMjhiB5lfzucTkeIPsofy34N5eIwdxBZoWJsevI5-yink3bbLx6zvNMxXdM8WnPeRBWb_7l7sRnwEAAP__whCiEA)
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTGP2zAMhX-NvMWQJUWuBw0FjHRKG3TpKDAS5RC1LJ8k53D__uAk4003knx8jx_472zPQDMt02-IaKa0rjYXCxmL27AiRCprxhUyLVNN0Qou9IEPB3G04Crd0SpovFGglda6QdP1A5eaK8Gbmwkavbr2grtrQOk0YucUonKBd0L2vCGzG_JBHLsfgndDOxx96IerdApFx1ExxdFTTbndb8tYyONSCebWpdjM5lbrWpj8ycSJiVNBt2VsS9oWn0LIiD7FsFdQKS1tytOuSsE-ATOC_xAPKCZPJW3ZoXXJI5Pjrz-Xy99OiV4rJvRWo43oaYtMjhiB5lfzucTkeIPsofy34N5eIwdxBZoWJsevI5-yink3bbLx6zvNMxXdM8WnPeRBWb_7l7sRnwEAAP__whCiEA)
---
My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ to expose the terrible evil of human trafficking. But making a movie was never enough. That is why we created **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **Stop the sale of God 's children.** And right now, we are supporting trusted partners working alongside police and prosecutors as this rescue effort develops. **But there is a serious problem**. Investigators still do not know where the victims are kept when they are not at the brothel.So when police move, the women and girls may be there, or new information may send the team to another location. **Everything can change quickly. **More people may be needed. More time. More transportation. More supplies. And additional help for survivors **after** they are brought to safety. That's why we urgently need to raise **$5,000 to help support this effort with rescue kits for trafficking victims**.
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTGP2zAMhX-NvMWQJUWuBw0FjHRKG3TpKDAS5RC1LJ8k53D__uAk4003knx8jx_472zPQDMt02-IaKa0rjYXCxmL27AiRCprxhUyLVNN0Qou9IEPB3G04Crd0SpovFGglda6QdP1A5eaK8Gbmwkavbr2grtrQOk0YucUonKBd0L2vCGzG_JBHLsfgndDOxx96IerdApFx1ExxdFTTbndb8tYyONSCebWpdjM5lbrWpj8ycSJiVNBt2VsS9oWn0LIiD7FsFdQKS1tytOuSsE-ATOC_xAPKCZPJW3ZoXXJI5Pjrz-Xy99OiV4rJvRWo43oaYtMjhiB5lfzucTkeIPsofy34N5eIwdxBZoWJsevI5-yink3bbLx6zvNMxXdM8WnPeRBWb_7l7sRnwEAAP__whCiEA)
---
**Friend, rescue is not simply opening a door. ****It is walking with someone through that door.** Our partners stay involved from intelligence and planning through victim recovery, safeguarding, and aftercare. Because leaving the place where you were exploited may only be the first step. A survivor may have nothing. No safe place to sleep. No money. She may fear the traffickers will hurt her family. She may even need help getting safely back to her home country and family. That's why rescue kits can matter so much.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTGP2zAMhX-NvMWQJUWuBw0FjHRKG3TpKDAS5RC1LJ8k53D__uAk4003knx8jx_472zPQDMt02-IaKa0rjYXCxmL27AiRCprxhUyLVNN0Qou9IEPB3G04Crd0SpovFGglda6QdP1A5eaK8Gbmwkavbr2grtrQOk0YucUonKBd0L2vCGzG_JBHLsfgndDOxx96IerdApFx1ExxdFTTbndb8tYyONSCebWpdjM5lbrWpj8ycSJiVNBt2VsS9oWn0LIiD7FsFdQKS1tytOuSsE-ATOC_xAPKCZPJW3ZoXXJI5Pjrz-Xy99OiV4rJvRWo43oaYtMjhiB5lfzucTkeIPsofy34N5eIwdxBZoWJsevI5-yink3bbLx6zvNMxXdM8WnPeRBWb_7l7sRnwEAAP__whCiEA)
---
Each kit contains a blanket, hygiene products, snacks, a notebook and pen, and one small item that can become a **lifeline** : **A card with our partner 's contact information.** Not every woman encountered during an operation will leave immediately. Some fear losing belongings hidden elsewhere. Some may have a child being controlled by traffickers. Others fear retaliation against themselves or their families. We never want a woman who is too afraid to leave that day to believe her chance for freedom is gone. **She can hold onto that card. **And when she is ready,**she knows who to call**. That is what your gift builds.
---
* **$25 puts one rescue kit in a survivor's hands.**
* **$50 provides two.**
* **$100 provides four.**
* **$250 provides ten** **-- enough for an entire operation**.

---
Every kit is a blanket around her shoulders. Something to eat. A way to feel human again. And a card that says someone is waiting to help, whenever she is ready. **Our $5,000 goal is 200 kits. Two hundred women and girls who will not walk out with nothing. **
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTGP2zAMhX-NvMWQJUWuBw0FjHRKG3TpKDAS5RC1LJ8k53D__uAk4003knx8jx_472zPQDMt02-IaKa0rjYXCxmL27AiRCprxhUyLVNN0Qou9IEPB3G04Crd0SpovFGglda6QdP1A5eaK8Gbmwkavbr2grtrQOk0YucUonKBd0L2vCGzG_JBHLsfgndDOxx96IerdApFx1ExxdFTTbndb8tYyONSCebWpdjM5lbrWpj8ycSJiVNBt2VsS9oWn0LIiD7FsFdQKS1tytOuSsE-ATOC_xAPKCZPJW3ZoXXJI5Pjrz-Xy99OiV4rJvRWo43oaYtMjhiB5lfzucTkeIPsofy34N5eIwdxBZoWJsevI5-yink3bbLx6zvNMxXdM8WnPeRBWb_7l7sRnwEAAP__whCiEA)
---
And our work cannot stop there. Survivors may need help rebuilding their lives and finding a safe way to support themselves. Without stability and economic independence, the same vulnerability that traffickers exploited can put a survivor in danger again. This is why **Sound of Freedom Foundation** fights trafficking on many fronts, from prevention and intervention to education and survivor support. And somewhere in South America, young women trapped inside a trafficking network may soon have a chance to walk free. They came from several Latin American countries. They were promised real jobs. A chance to earn money. A chance for a better life. But police say that once these young women were brought under the control of a well-known criminal gang, the promises disappeared. Instead, they were forced into commercial sexual exploitation. And threatened with violence or death. Then police went undercover at a brothel tied to the organization. What they found made this even more urgent. Several of the young women they encountered may be minors. Now, authorities are preparing to act. And I am asking you to help us be ready. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film Sound of Freedom to expose the terrible evil of human trafficking. But making a movie was never enough. That is why we created Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: Stop the sale of God 's children. And right now, we are supporting trusted partners working alongside police and prosecutors as this rescue effort develops. But there is a serious problem. Investigators still do not know where the victims are kept when they are not at the brothel.So when police move, the women and girls may be there, or new information may send the team to another location. Everything can change quickly. More people may be needed. More time. More transportation. More supplies. And additional help for survivors after they are brought to safety. That's why we urgently need to raise $5,000 to help support this effort with rescue kits for trafficking victims. Friend, rescue is not simply opening a door. It is walking with someone through that door. Our partners stay involved from intelligence and planning through victim recovery, safeguarding, and aftercare. Because leaving the place where you were exploited may only be the first step. A survivor may have nothing. No safe place to sleep. No money. She may fear the traffickers will hurt her family. She may even need help getting safely back to her home country and family. That's why rescue kits can matter so much. Each kit contains a blanket, hygiene products, snacks, a notebook and pen, and one small item that can become a lifeline : A card with our partner 's contact information. Not every woman encountered during an operation will leave immediately. Some fear losing belongings hidden elsewhere. Some may have a child being controlled by traffickers. Others fear retaliation against themselves or their families. We never want a woman who is too afraid to leave that day to believe her chance for freedom is gone. She can hold onto that card. And when she is ready,she knows who to call. That is what your gift builds. $25 puts one rescue kit in a survivor's hands. $50 provides two. $100 provides four. $250 provides ten -- enough for an entire operation. Every kit is a blanket around her shoulders. Something to eat. A way to feel human again. And a card that says someone is waiting to help, whenever she is ready. Our $5,000 goal is 200 kits. Two hundred women and girls who will not walk out with nothing. And our work cannot stop there. Survivors may need help rebuilding their lives and finding a safe way to support themselves. Without stability and economic independence, the same vulnerability that traffickers exploited can put a survivor in danger again. This is why Sound of Freedom Foundation fights trafficking on many fronts, from prevention and intervention to education and survivor support. subject: Police may have found trafficked minors. Now they must act.
body:
Young women may soon have a chance to escape a trafficking network. Your gift can help rescuers be ready.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
**A rescue is about to happen.** And somewhere in South America, young women trapped inside a trafficking network may soon have a chance to walk free. They came from several Latin American countries. They were promised **real jobs.** A chance to earn money. **A chance for a better life.** But police say that once these young women were brought under the control of a well-known criminal gang, the promises disappeared. Instead, they were forced into commercial sexual exploitation. **And threatened with violence or death.** Then police went undercover at a brothel tied to the organization. What they found made this even more urgent. Several of the young women they encountered **may be minors**. Now, authorities are preparing to act. **And I am asking you to help us be ready.**
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)

My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ to expose the terrible evil of human trafficking. But making a movie was never enough. That is why we created **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **Stop the sale of God 's children.** And right now, we are supporting trusted partners working alongside police and prosecutors as this rescue effort develops. **But there is a serious problem**. Investigators still do not know where the victims are kept when they are not at the brothel.So when police move, the women and girls may be there, or new information may send the team to another location. **Everything can change quickly. **More people may be needed. More time. More transportation. More supplies. And additional help for survivors **after** they are brought to safety. That's why we urgently need to raise **$5,000 to help support this effort with rescue kits for trafficking victims**.
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)
---
**Friend, rescue is not simply opening a door. ****It is walking with someone through that door.** Our partners stay involved from intelligence and planning through victim recovery, safeguarding, and aftercare. Because leaving the place where you were exploited may only be the first step. A survivor may have nothing. No safe place to sleep. No money. She may fear the traffickers will hurt her family. She may even need help getting safely back to her home country and family. That's why rescue kits can matter so much.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)
---
Each kit contains a blanket, hygiene products, snacks, a notebook and pen, and one small item that can become a **lifeline** : **A card with our partner 's contact information.** Not every woman encountered during an operation will leave immediately. Some fear losing belongings hidden elsewhere. Some may have a child being controlled by traffickers. Others fear retaliation against themselves or their families. We never want a woman who is too afraid to leave that day to believe her chance for freedom is gone. **She can hold onto that card. **And when she is ready,**she knows who to call**. That is what your gift builds.
---
* **$25 puts one rescue kit in a survivor's hands.**
* **$50 provides two.**
* **$100 provides four.**
* **$250 provides ten** **-- enough for an entire operation**.

---
Every kit is a blanket around her shoulders. Something to eat. A way to feel human again. And a card that says someone is waiting to help, whenever she is ready. **Our $5,000 goal is 200 kits. Two hundred women and girls who will not walk out with nothing. **
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)
---
And our work cannot stop there. Survivors may need help rebuilding their lives and finding a safe way to support themselves. Without stability and economic independence, the same vulnerability that traffickers exploited can put a survivor in danger again. This is why **Sound of Freedom Foundation** fights trafficking on many fronts, from prevention and intervention to education and survivor support. Jesus said: _" Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me."_ (Matthew 25:40) **Those words call us to more than sorrow. ****They call us to ACT.** Friend, you may never meet the young woman your gift helps. You may never know her name. But you can help make sure trusted people are there when her moment to escape finally comes. **[Will you give $25, $50, $100, $250, or whatever God puts on your heart right now?](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)**
---
[ **Help Rescuers Be Ready**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7s7CYOyloIi02u5SRJFSovEwrNGBcQBvdP8-8t6WqdLOvHlvPr1f7_YdQgzb_TskMqV5W6rdcwxICT5XeJDPx-ZaAe8DWsHF9Mb1m1AWsIUH2RE6Zxw6GLAjM8yay2ngUnSr0aOQ4CavSSyXwXPnuJqE8lo6rZZx6II5_bgWarhILnSPWvkRL7Pky4LKSzZyiFRaX2g_lhgQtgb1w-eC1GNOXTRra3tl8hsTNyZulfAo1Nfz5-x9IXI5PQmghbz1udxPVfa2UMWDCoH7FE8sJm81HwXJYnbE5PXHz9swinlWTExHSzaRC0di8koJQnwNv06YvK5QHNQPC_j7tUJIO4T7xuT134FfskblNO2KcfufEGOo08xGfj9DnoztP2t5GPE3AAD__5yzoWI)

We do not know exactly what investigators will find. We do not know how many victims will be there, and we do not know how many will be ready to leave. **But we must be ready when that moment comes. **Because when good people refuse to remain silent, darkness loses ground. **Please pray for these women and girls. ****Pray for the police, prosecutors, and rescue partners entering this dangerous situation.** And please give if you can. **Together, let us say with our prayers, our voices, and our actions: ****God 's children are not for sale. **With gratitude and prayer,

Donald Trump carried this district in 2024, and he picked John Braun to try to take this seat back. I've never pretended this would be easy. I ran an auto repair shop with my husband before I ever ran for office. You learn fast that nobody fixes your problems for you. You roll up your sleeves and do the work. That's how I've tried to represent Southwest Washington. I don't take marching orders from either party. I show up for the people who build, fix, farm, and fish in this district. Mai is the daughter of Hmong refugees, born and raised in Sacramento. Mai’s parents fled war in Laos and arrived in California to find a new life.

clean_body: | = It’s Jane Fonda. I’ve always believed that being a celebrity comes with a certain responsibility to use your platform for something bigger than yourself. And with less than 6 weeks until Election Day, I’m reaching out with an urgent request for something bigger than any of us: My team set a goal to bring in 2,500 unique online donations by midnight on September 30. This is one of our final major benchmarks before November, and with so much on the line — fighting for a livable future, standing up to this administration, and defending against Big Oil cash — we can’t afford to have anyone on the sidelines. = We don’t have time to waste. Our candidates are up against massive odds: dark money from greedy special interests, billionaire-funded attacks, and opponents who want to make it harder for us to vote them out of power. Over 1.2 million registered Texas voters were placed on voter "suspense lists” – the vast majority likely have no idea they’re even on this list. And that’s the point. These are deliberate attempts to cause confusion, undermine our democracy, and drown out pro-people and anti-fossil fuel voices running for office. Our opponents can see that voters are demanding change. They know their time’s up. And with people like you on our side, we aren't going to let them bully us into complacency. Instead, we’re harnessing that energy to organize non-stop in these final 39 days, texting undecided voters, holding phonebanks with our candidates, and making sure our communities have plans to vote. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being in this fight with me. xx Jane Fonda | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. **Today is the final day to sign up. Seating is limited for this special event, and RSVP is required. If you haven’t already RSVPed, sign up today to reserve your spot!**
Speaker of the House Mike Johnson is coming back to Washington to support John Braun in one of the most closely watched congressional races in the country.
Just weeks after joining John in Vancouver, Speaker Johnson is returning to headline a special fundraising roundtable and reception in Olympia on **Tuesday, September 29**.

His return underscores the national attention surrounding this race. Washington’s 3rd Congressional District is one of a small number of competitive seats that will determine which party controls the U.S. House next year, and national leaders are investing their time here because they know John can win this seat.
This is a unique opportunity to hear directly from **Speaker Johnson and John Braun** about the stakes in WA-03, the fight for control of Congress, and the work ahead in the final weeks before Election Day.
**Tuesday, September 29, 2026**
**5:30–6:15 p.m.**
**Olympia, Washington**

**Private Roundtable: $3,500/person**

midterms.

We don't have much time. Our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is on Wednesday, and we're not where we need to be to hit our goal.
I'm hoping there's something I can say to convince you to [make a $7 donation to my U.S. Senate campaign right now to help me out.](https://substack.com/redirect/b0de48d0-bd55-436a-85c3-3d5ec688701a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What if I told you that President Trump, Vice President Vance and MAGA loyalist Stephen Miller are all personally attacking me and supporting my opponent?
What if I told you that Republicans are spending over $100 million so far to defeat me - and now, with the Senate GOP super PAC going live more attack ads against me, we're officially getting outspent.
What if I told you that the GOP's surge of spending is hitting our momentum hard, and a recent poll shows my narrow lead in this race cut to a statistical tie?
**Republicans are going all in to defeat me, because if we lose in North Carolina, Democrats will lose our chance to take back the Senate. That 's what is at stake in this race - and that's why I'm asking:**
[Will you chip in $7 now to help us reach our crucial end-of-quarter goal so we can fight back against GOP attacks, protect our slim polling lead and flip North Carolina blue? I need your help.](https://substack.com/redirect/b0de48d0-bd55-436a-85c3-3d5ec688701a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b0de48d0-bd55-436a-85c3-3d5ec688701a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The amount you pitch in doesn't matter nearly as much as the fact that you're pitching in at all. Thank you so much.
Roy Cooper

The Regime Open — September 25, 2026
Iran Named a Deadline. The US and China Just Moved Theirs.
Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within seven days of a deal; Washington wants nuclear talks first. Trump and Xi bought two more months on trade. Neither story resolved — and yields hit a fresh 19-year high regardless.
|
---
Thursday delivered concrete outcomes on both of the diplomatic tracks this newsletter has followed all week — and both landed as extensions of the status quo rather than breakthroughs. **Verified fact:** Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days of U.S. acceptance, saying “the Strait of Hormuz would be open on the end of the seventh day and [peace] talks would restart,” a proposal resembling the collapsed June memorandum. Secretary of State Rubio cautioned against calling the talks “a major breakthrough.” Separately, Trump and Xi extended their tariff truce through January 10, leaving Taiwan, AI, and rare-earth questions unresolved. Equities were roughly flat — S&P; 500 -0.07%, Nasdaq -0.06%, Dow -0.32% — while oil rose (WTI +1.04% to $93.12, Brent +1.53% to $104.70) and the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.192%, its highest since 2007.
| | Regime Signal 01 — Iran's Offer Is Concrete, But the Disagreement Is Structural, Not Cosmetic
---|---
**Verified fact:** Washington wants Iran's nuclear program addressed immediately; Iran insists on sequencing — reopening the strait first, nuclear talks later. **Our interpretation:** this is a genuine, specific proposal with a genuine, specific sticking point, which is a meaningful upgrade in precision over weeks of vaguer diplomatic signaling. But a sequencing disagreement this fundamental — what comes first, sanctions relief or nuclear verification — has derailed comparable frameworks before, including the June memorandum this plan explicitly echoes.
| | Regime Signal 02 — A Trade Truce Extension Is a Deadline Deferral, Not a Resolution
---|---
**Verified fact:** the new January 10 deadline replaces the November 10 rare-earth deadline this newsletter flagged as the key date to watch, buying roughly two additional months without resolving the underlying disagreements on Taiwan, AI, or rare-earth export policy. **Our interpretation:** extending a deadline under pressure, as both sides did here, is meaningfully different from resolving what the deadline was about — it removes near-term uncertainty while leaving the substantive dispute fully intact for a later date.
| | Regime Signal 03 — The Bond Market Isn't Waiting for Either Story to Resolve
---|---
**Verified fact:** the 10-year yield's move to 5.192% and the 30-year's move to 5.476% — its highest since 2004 — came on the same day as both diplomatic developments, with oil rising rather than falling. **Our interpretation:** this is now the third consecutive session of broad-based yield strength this newsletter has tracked, increasingly independent of whether the week's diplomatic news is positive or negative — the clearest evidence yet that a structural rate repricing, not day-to-day headlines, is now the dominant driver.
| | This Week’s Confirmation Point
---|---
Whether Washington formally responds to Iran's seven-day Hormuz proposal, and whether the sequencing disagreement (strait first vs. nuclear first) narrows or hardens in the coming days.

Policy Transmission — September 25, 2026
The Trump-Xi Summit Did Exactly What Low Expectations Predicted
A two-month trade truce extension, a warm handshake, and Taiwan, AI, and rare earths all still unresolved — the summit matched its muted preview almost point for point.
|
---
| | The Mechanism
---|---
This newsletter flagged Thursday's Trump-Xi summit as arriving with already-discounted expectations. The actual outcome matched that muted baseline almost exactly: enough progress to avoid a breakdown, not enough to resolve anything substantive.
| | What Was Actually Agreed
---|---
**Verified fact:** Trump and Xi's trade officials extended their tariff truce through January 10, replacing the November 10 rare-earth export deadline this newsletter has tracked for a week. Xi received what was described as “a rare planeside greeting” from Trump, a symbolic gesture of goodwill. **Reported claim:** Taiwan's pending $14 billion arms package, AI cooperation, and the underlying rare-earth export dispute all remain unresolved per multiple summit recaps.
| | Regime Classification: PRESSURE, Deferred Rather Than Resolved
---|---
**Our interpretation:** a two-month extension is a rational outcome for two sides that, as one Bloomberg headline put it, are “neither able to afford a fight” — it buys time without requiring either side to concede on Taiwan or rare earths. **What remains unknown** is whether the additional two months produces genuine progress on the harder issues, or simply moves the same unresolved cliff edge from November to January, when markets will face the identical uncertainty with less runway to negotiate a further extension.
| | Why the Symbolic Gesture Matters Less Than the Deadline
---|---
A warm greeting photographs well but does not bind either government to a substantive position. **Next confirmation point:** any concrete movement on the Taiwan arms package or rare-earth licensing specifics in the weeks following the summit, which would distinguish genuine progress from a simple deadline extension.

name: Citizens for Amanda Pusczek
subject: Election Day is around the corner — let’s connect in your community
body:
Every single thing we do between now and November 3rd is important.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | Dear friend,
Election Day is coming fast, and every single conversation we have between now and November matters. Across Alabama’s 4th Congressional District, neighbors are hungry for real representation, practical solutions, and leadership that listens.
Because we’re down to the final stretch, Amanda’s campaign calendar is filling up quickly. We want to make sure we reach every corner of the district before votes are cast, and we need your help to do it.
Here are two high-impact ways you can make a direct difference right now:
* **Host an event in your community:** If you would like Amanda or campaign leadership to visit your neighborhood, host a meet-and-greet, or hold a living room conversation, **reply directly to this email**. Let us know what kind of event you have in mind and where you're located so our team can coordinate details while dates remain open.
* **Canvass on your own schedule:** You don’t need to attend a scheduled weekend block to get out the vote. If you want to knock doors but have an unpredictable schedule, **simply reply to this email with the neighborhood, town, or area where you'd like to walk**. Our organizing team will build you a targeted voter list and arrange a packet of campaign literature for you to use whenever your schedule allows.

This grassroots momentum only works when folks step up to lead where they live. Whether it's opening your front porch to neighbors or walking a couple of blocks on a free afternoon, your involvement turns out voters.

---
Hit reply, let us know how you want to plug in, and our team will follow up right away with everything you need.
**With gratitude and determination,******Team Pusczek******Amanda Pusczek for Congress (AL-04)**

Football season is back!

I'm more partial to baseball, but Ohio State football is a way of life in this state, and I’m proud to be cheering on the Buckeyes this year as they fight to win another national championship.

Here's why I'm writing about college football in a campaign email.

When Ohio State played Texas a few weeks ago, 16 million people watched. It was the most-watched Week 2 college football game EVER. In Columbus, nearly half the households with a TV had the game on.

**There's no other moment when this many Ohioans are so tuned in – which makes commercials during the game the best chance we get to reach voters who don't follow politics at all.**

It's also the most expensive. A 30-second commercial on a normal Saturday afternoon in Columbus would take us back a few thousand dollars. But to afford one during the OSU game, it can cost many times that, even running up a bill of $100K+.

And the clock is running. Early voting starts in just 11 days, the polls are statistically tied, and Republicans are coordinating their spending to defeat me. They’re even pulling money out of other states so they can ramp up their attacks in Ohio.

**[Which brings me to today. Our fundraising deadline is at midnight, and we're not on track to hit our daily goal of $400,000. body:
Gabe Evans on his record, his opponent and a race inside the margin

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

PRESENTED BY ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Hi friends! Happy Friday,

Here's a summary of today's top stories:

🏔️ HERE IN COLORADO... Colorado's touted 9.5% revenue growth
relies on expiring credits and accounting shifts
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
while forecasters flag a shrinking labor force and Medicaid overruns
as the real budget drivers; in the tossup 8th District, Rep. Gabe
Evans blasted opponent Manny Rutinel's DSA-aligned record
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
in a race within the margin of error; and a lawsuit seeks to strike
Amendment 87 from the ballot
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
over alleged petition violations.

🇺🇸 ON THE NATIONAL STAGE... DSA's platform calls for defunding
police "towards zero" and abolishing prisons
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
but its proposed alternative, restorative justice, shows no reduction
in violent reoffending and requires offender cooperation — leaving
unanswered what happens to those who won't comply, a question DSA
declined to answer for RMV.

🗣️ COMMENTARY SPOTLIGHT... Dr. Brian Joondeph examines a
Rasmussen survey showing Democrats report mental-health diagnoses at
higher rates
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
than Republicans; Greg Walcher backs Amendment 83's constitutional
hunting/fishing protections
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
citing $2.5 billion in economic impact; and Joondeph questions whether
alarm over AI safety from industry and politicians echoes COVID-era
rhetoric aimed at cementing Big Tech's advantage
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, September 25, 2026.

– Team RMV

TODAY'S TOP STORIES

GABE EVANS ON HIS RECORD, HIS OPPONENT AND A RACE INSIDE THE MARGIN
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Gabe Evans still tells the story of his first annual review as a cop.

His sergeant sat him down and said he’d had a great year. Forty-one
arrests, putting him in the top half of the shift. More than 1,800
calls for service.

“If you do the math, that means less than 2% of the time I’m there
to actually criminally charge someone as a cop,” Evans told RMV.
“98% of the time, I’m involving non-criminal issues in the
community. I’m de-escalating a problem or connecting someone to
resources.”

READ MORE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

COLORADO BUDGET IMPROVES 9.5 PERCENT WHILE SPENDING, NOT REVENUE,
DRIVES THE SHORTFALL
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_A headline 9.5% revenue growth number hides a shrinking labor force
and a state keeping more taxpayer refunds than it used to_.

*
THE GROWTH IS MOSTLY PROJECTION, NOT REALITY: Actual General Fund
revenue grew just 0.3% last year to $17.23 billion, while the 9.5%
figure is a forecast resting on expiring tax credits and a corporate
tax rebound tied to federal accounting changes, not real economic
growth.

*
A SHRINKING WORKFORCE BEHIND THE NUMBERS: Colorado's labor force has
fallen 2% since 2024, nearly 67,000 workers, a decline state
forecasters say has historically only occurred during a recession,
with labor force participation at its lowest since at least 1976
outside the pandemic.

*
THE STATE IS KEEPING MORE OF WHAT IT COLLECTS: Legislative Council
Staff say spending, not revenue, is driving the budget's
deterioration, with Medicaid alone running $213.1 million over budget,
even as measures like Proposition NN and the Kids Matter Account move
to reduce TABOR refunds and divert revenue that would otherwise go
back to taxpayers.

READ MORE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

DSA WANTS TO ABOLISH POLICE AND PRISONS. ITS PLAN FOR VIOLENT
OFFENDERS GOES UNSTATED
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_A DSA leader confirmed the group's goal is abolishing police and
prisons, but couldn't say what replaces them for violent offenders._

*
GOAL CONFIRMED, DETAILS DODGED: DSA leader Frances Gill told an NBC LA
anchor the group wants police and prisons abolished, but declined to
say what would stop or hold a rapist accountable without them.

*
A PLATFORM WITH NO ENDGAME: DSA's program calls for cutting police
budgets "annually towards zero," while its favored alternative,
restorative justice, shows no measurable effect on violent reoffending
per a 2025 meta-analysis.

*
EVEN ALLIES WON'T FOLLOW IT: DSA-aligned Mayor Zohran Mamdani and
candidate Francesca Hong have distanced themselves from the plank, and
DSA didn't respond when asked what stops a murderer in a world without
prisons.

A THREE-VOTE DISTRICT, A 30-YEAR TEACHER, AND THE CASE JILL HAFFLEY IS
MAKING TO HD16
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | SEPTEMBER 22

_Jill Haffley knocks on thousands of doors, and she has noticed that
almost nobody wants to argue about politics on their own porch.
“Most people aren’t interested in having a partisan argument on
their front porch,” she said. “They want to know whether they can
afford groceries, utilities, insurance, and housing. They want safe
neighborhoods and good schools. They want government to make sense
with minimal interference in their daily lives.”_

clean_body: Next week, Washington will receive the first payment from our historic Meta settlement. | Hi Peter, The first payment of more than $30 million from our historic settlement with Meta is coming to Washington next week. I was proud to be part of the team of attorneys general from across the country that took on Meta over allegations that the company knowingly failed to protect children on its platforms. Together, we helped secure a settlement of up to $17 billion , the largest Big Tech settlement in history. For Washington, the settlement will provide at least $237 million to help enforce consumer protections and address the mental health impacts of social media on young people , with the potential for nearly $339 million over the next decade. That first payment of more than $30 million will arrive on October 1. The settlement means more than just money coming back to Washington. Meta will be required to make real changes to how it designs its products for kids and teens, including time limits, nighttime restrictions, stronger age verification, safer content controls, and limits on features tied to harmful social comparison. I’ve pushed for years to hold companies like Meta accountable when their products harm kids. This settlement shows what we can accomplish when we stand together and take on even the most powerful corporations. If corporations want to target our kids, they should know this: we will hold them accountable. We will fight back. We will take them on in court. Folks, it’s James Carville.

I’ve spent nearly half a century helping Democrats win elections, and I’m gonna tell you something plainly:

**For too long, we have waited until the house was already on fire before deciding to buy a hose.**

We wait until a race becomes a crisis.

We wait until a great candidate is getting buried in attack ads.

We wait until Republicans have already built the infrastructure, raised the money, and defined the battlefield.

Then everybody starts running around asking what happened.

Well, Raja Krishnamoorthi has gone and done something about it.

He founded [**Equal Opportunity Now**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139969286/649096888/1090555623?refcode=260925_carville_resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDM3MDc3ZS0xN2I5LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Au31Pm8zdtbrbVAOrrTU6A3i89NTI6tbNuiFKYfxnxY=) to find and support bold leaders and important causes before it’s too late — leaders who will stand up to Donald Trump and the MAGA movement, fight for working families, and actually deliver results.

And all I can say is:

**FINALLY.**

Finally, an organization that understands we cannot defeat MAGA with timid candidates, stale talking points, and a last-minute panic.

But Raja cannot build this by himself.

[**Will you contribute $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Equal Opportunity Now find, fund, and support the leaders Democrats need to start winning again?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139969287/649096889/1090555623?refcode=260925_carville_resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDM3MDc3ZS0xN2I5LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Au31Pm8zdtbrbVAOrrTU6A3i89NTI6tbNuiFKYfxnxY=)

Now, I know Raja.
He is smart. He is tough. And he knows firsthand what opportunity can mean.
His family came to this country with very little. They relied on public housing and food stamps. He worked his way from Peoria all the way to Congress.
And instead of pulling the ladder up behind him, Raja has spent his career fighting to make sure the next family gets the same shot.
That means standing up for workers.
Holding powerful corporations and corrupt politicians accountable.
Defending immigrants, voting rights, and every American targeted by Trump’s politics of division.
And now he is putting that experience toward building the next generation of Democratic leadership.
**Here’s the truth: The leaders we need are already out there.**
They are running for city council, state legislature, Congress, and offices most national donors are not paying attention to yet.
They have the courage.
They have the ideas.
What they do not always have is the money, infrastructure, and early support necessary to compete.
That is where Equal Opportunity Now comes in.

Friend, There is a moment before a jump where the door is open, the wind is so loud you can't hear the man next to you, and you are standing there with eighty pounds strapped to your body waiting on a green light.
I did that for the 82nd Airborne. Then the 101st. Then I spent nine months in Baghdad. You would think a man who has stood in that door a few hundred times wouldn't get nervous about much of anything.
I thought so too.
Then my team sat me down this week and showed me _**where we stand going into September 30th.**_

**_Let me explain._**
This is Mike Bouchard. Captain, United States Army, and the Republican nominee for Michigan's 10th District.
**I 'll be honest with you — campaigning is harder than jumping out of airplanes.** Out there I knew exactly what my job was. Here, some days it feels like the weight of this whole district is sitting on my shoulders.
Because the Democrats have decided Michigan's 10th is how they take back the House. _**Not a seat in California. Not New York. Ours.**_
My opponent spent nearly every dollar she raised getting through her primary. That means Washington is about to write her a very large check - and Washington's money always comes with Washington's strings attached. _**September 30th is our End-of-Quarter deadline.**_
This isn't just an arbitrary date. It's the LAST end-of-quarter deadline of this campaign. Every deadline I've ever asked you about had another one behind it. This one doesn't. After the 30th there is no next quarter - there's just the election.
What we raise in the next few days pays for the _**door-knockers in Sterling Heights,**_ the yard signs across Macomb, and the ads that reach the folks in this district who haven't made up their minds yet.
I'm not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets.
_**All I'm asking is a $1 or more donation, which goes straight into this campaign and helps us hold Michigan's 10th in November.**_
**As a combat veteran — and as a guy whose grandfather worked thirty-three years at the GM plant in Warren — I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I am grateful for ANY gift you can make.**
**Please donate below! ⬇️**

clean_body: They're about to spend millions to take this seat| | | Friend, There is a moment before a jump where the door is open, the wind is so loud you can't hear the man next to you, and you are standing there with eighty pounds strapped to your body waiting on a green light. I did that for the 82nd Airborne. Then the 101st. Then I spent nine months in Baghdad. You would think a man who has stood in that door a few hundred times wouldn't get nervous about much of anything. I thought so too. Then my team sat me down this week and showed me where we stand going into September 30th. Let me explain. This is Mike Bouchard. Captain, United States Army, and the Republican nominee for Michigan's 10th District. I 'll be honest with you — campaigning is harder than jumping out of airplanes. Out there I knew exactly what my job was. Here, some days it feels like the weight of this whole district is sitting on my shoulders. Because the Democrats have decided Michigan's 10th is how they take back the House. Not a seat in California. Not New York. Ours. My opponent spent nearly every dollar she raised getting through her primary. That means Washington is about to write her a very large check - and Washington's money always comes with Washington's strings attached. September 30th is our End-of-Quarter deadline. This isn't just an arbitrary date. It's the LAST end-of-quarter deadline of this campaign. Every deadline I've ever asked you about had another one behind it. This one doesn't. After the 30th there is no next quarter - there's just the election. What we raise in the next few days pays for the door-knockers in Sterling Heights, the yard signs across Macomb, and the ads that reach the folks in this district who haven't made up their minds yet. I'm not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I'm asking is a $1 or more donation, which goes straight into this campaign and helps us hold Michigan's 10th in November. As a combat veteran — and as a guy whose grandfather worked thirty-three years at the GM plant in Warren — I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I am grateful for ANY gift you can make. Please donate below! ⬇️ | Time is running out. Thank you for reading this far, and I hope I can count on your help.
